To effectively optimize the skills, we build the EditAdam with internally maintained dual states. Through the three-phase interleaved updates with EditAdam, the system monotonically improves without gradient or parameter tuning. Extensive experiments and detailed ablations across 5 benchmarks and 3 target LLMs demonstrate that MOSCOPT consistently outperforms all baselines, and confirm that both the mixture-of-skills architecture with selective activation and the collective evolution with three-phase interleaving are essential to its superior performance. Code is released https://github.com/zhangzhenyu13/SummerClaw/tree/master/summerclaw/agent_trainer/algorithms/moscopt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MOSCOPT，一种免参数、文本原生的提示与技能联合优化算法，通过同时优化 N 个技能池与门控技能 G 实现每步动态选择 K 个技能，并借助 EditAdam 三阶段交替更新实现系统单调提升。
AI.motivation: 现有提示与技能优化方法均只优化单一文本模板，忽略了多种互补策略之间的协同效应（synergy），因而性能受限。
AI.method: MOSCOPT 联合优化技能池（含 N 个技能）与门控技能 G，门控每步从池中选择 K 个技能；为有效优化技能，引入内部维护双重状态的 EditAdam，并通过三阶段交替更新（three-phase interleaved updates）实现无需梯度与参数调优的单调改进。
AI.result: 在 5 个基准与 3 个目标 LLM 上的大量实验与消融表明，MOSCOPT 一致优于所有基线；消融证实“带选择性激活的技能混合架构”与“三阶段交替的集体演化”对性能优势均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: MOSCOPT 以文本原生、免参数的方式实现了多技能协同优化，验证了技能混合与选择性激活机制的有效性，代码已开源。

title: Policy Loopholes in Agent Evaluation: When Policy Ambiguity Masquerades as Agent Error
comment: Accepted at REALM EMNLP 2026
summary: Agent benchmarks evaluate policy compliance but assume each policy determines a unique correct action. Natural-language policies can violate this assumption through silence, ambiguity, or contradiction, admitting multiple defensible readings that a single gold trajectory cannot capture. Auditing two $τ^2$-bench domains, we develop a taxonomy of such policy loopholes and show that affected tasks produce unreliable scores: they lower scores across different models in different ways and make every model less consistent across repeated trials. A cross-domain comparison reveals that exploitability requires both policy ambiguity and tool permissiveness: when policy complexity exceeds what tools can enforce, agents resolve gaps inconsistently and scores become unreliable. Policy specification quality sets the ceiling on evaluation quality. Benchmark developers should audit policies before collecting gold annotations.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了Agent基准测试中自然语言策略的漏洞，发现策略的沉默、歧义或矛盾会产生多种可辩护解读，导致评分不可靠，且可利用性取决于策略歧义与工具宽松性的叠加。
AI.motivation: Agent基准测试通常假设每条策略对应唯一正确动作，但自然语言策略可能因沉默、歧义或矛盾而包含多种合理理解，单一标准轨迹无法覆盖，从而威胁评估的有效性。
AI.method: 审计两个 τ²-bench 领域，构建策略漏洞的分类体系，并分析受影响任务在跨模型评分与重复试验一致性上的表现，同时进行跨领域比较以考察策略歧义与工具宽松性的作用。
AI.result: 受漏洞影响的任务会产生不可靠评分：以不同方式降低不同模型的得分，并削弱所有模型在重复试验中的一致性；跨领域比较表明，可利用性需同时具备策略歧义与工具宽松性，当策略复杂度超出工具可执行范围时，Agent会不一致地填补空白，评分随之不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 策略规范质量决定了评估质量的上限，基准开发者应在收集标准标注之前先审计策略。

title: Question's Gambit: The First Move Matters in Agentic Deep Search
summary: Deep research agents answer complex questions through iterative loops of searching, reading, and reasoning. Recent work on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as BrowseComp-Plus shows that well-configured lexical retrieval can surface high-quality evidence, yet agents may still fail to connect documents carrying evidence to the gold documents. We identify a deep research agent's first retrieval move as an important design decision for this setting. We introduce Question's Gambit, a first-move retrieval module that decomposes the question into a set of clues, reformulates them into complementary searches, consolidates the retrieved results, and reranks the candidate pool before the agent begins its iterative search-and-reasoning process. This produces an opening context designed to support both clue aggregation and final-answer verification. We further evaluate on MultiHop-RAG to test whether these benefits transfer beyond BrowseComp-Plus to a more conventional multi-hop question structure. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus show that Question's Gambit improves retrieval recall and downstream agent accuracy over strong baselines, improving answer accuracy from 83.1% to 90.5% with gpt-5.5 over Pi-Serini, the strongest reported agentic baseline. Our results confirm that effective agentic deep research depends not only on the tools available inside the loop, but also on the quality of the first move. We published our implementation publicly at https://github.com/radinhamidi/Question-s-Gambit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Question's Gambit，一种"首步检索"模块：将问题分解为线索、改写成互补检索式、合并结果并重排序，为深度研究智能体构造高质量的开局上下文。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上答案准确率由 83.1% 提升至 90.5%，并在 MultiHop-RAG 上验证了迁移性。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体通过"搜索—阅读—推理"的迭代循环回答复杂问题。已有工作（如 BrowseComp-Plus）表明配置良好的词法检索能召回高质量证据，但智能体仍可能无法把含有证据的文档与金标准文档关联起来。作者因此认为，智能体的"第一次检索动作"是这一场景下被忽视却关键的设计决策。
AI.method: 提出 Question's Gambit 首步检索模块，包含四个环节：将原问题分解为一组线索（clue decomposition）；把线索改写为互补的检索查询（complementary reformulation）；对检索结果进行合并归并（consolidation）；在智能体进入迭代搜索-推理循环之前对候选池重排序（reranking）。最终生成一个兼顾线索聚合与最终答案验证的"开局上下文"。
AI.result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，Question's Gambit 在检索召回率和下游智能体准确率上均优于强基线；在 gpt-5.5 下相较于最强已报告智能体基线 Pi-Serini，答案准确率从 83.1% 提升至 90.5%。此外在 MultiHop-RAG 上进行了评估，以检验收益能否从 BrowseComp-Plus 迁移到更常规的多跳问题结构。
AI.conclusion: 有效的智能体式深度研究不仅取决于循环内部可用的工具，还取决于"第一步动作"的质量。实现已开源于 https://github.com/radinhamidi/Question-s-Gambit。

title: Making Political Text Scaling Comparable: Infrastructure and Hyperparameter Sensitivity for 17 Algorithms
comment: Accepted for the 6th edition of the workshop on Computational Linguistics for the Political and Social Sciences (CPSS)
summary: Computational text-based ideal point estimation (CT-IPE) methods are usually compared as named algorithms, yet applying them involves numerous researcher choices that configure how political text is turned into position estimates. This paper argues that CT-IPE methods are better understood as configurable measurement pipelines than as fixed estimators. Building on a large-scale comparative experiment spanning 17 CT-IPE algorithms, 5,537 experimental runs, and approximately 4.25 million left-right position estimates, I describe the shared infrastructure that makes these heterogeneous methods jointly executable and quantify how sensitive their estimates are to alternative hyperparameter choices. Variance-partitioning and SHAP-based sensitivity analyses show that, for most algorithms, hyperparameter profiles explain little residual variance through a shared shift: 13 of the 17 algorithms exhibit ICC values below .10. Where this profile-level sensitivity is present, it is concentrated in a small number of consequential researcher choices, most notably the selection of the underlying language or embedding model, the seed keyword lists that anchor the construct, and the number of topics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将计算文本理想点估计（CT-IPE）方法理解为可配置的测量流水线，而非固定估计器。基于17种算法、5,537次实验、约425万条左右位置估计的大规模比较实验，量化了估计结果对超参数选择的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将CT-IPE方法作为具名算法进行比较，但实际应用中涉及大量研究者选择，这些选择共同决定了政治文本如何转化为位置估计，缺乏对这类"配置性"影响的系统量化。
AI.method: 构建使异质方法可联合执行的共享基础设施；开展涵盖17种CT-IPE算法、5,537次运行、约425万条左右位置估计的大规模比较实验；采用方差分解与基于SHAP的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 多数算法的超参数配置对残差方差的解释力较低，呈现共同偏移：17种算法中有13种的ICC值低于.10。存在配置层面敏感性时，其集中于少数关键研究者选择，主要是底层语言或嵌入模型的选择、锚定构念的种子关键词列表以及主题数量。
AI.conclusion: CT-IPE方法应被视为可配置的测量流水线；其估计对超参数的敏感性总体有限，且可归因于少数关键选择，这为跨方法比较与复现研究提供了新的方法论视角。

title: SlideLab: Audience-Centered Scientific Slide Generation and Evaluation
comment: Update Appendix and add few more ablations, ConfArena architecture
summary: Scientific presentations are more than summaries of research papers. They need to present the work in a coherent sequence, explain the main ideas clearly, and help the audience follow the presentation. We present SlideLab, a training-free multi-agent framework for generating scientific presentations from research papers. SlideLab first plans the presentation narrative, then builds and iteratively refines a shared slide deck using agents for content planning, visual generation, layout refinement, and grounding verification. In a blind human preference study, SlideLab was preferred over both open-source and commercial systems on 77% of papers while using roughly 4 times fewer inference tokens than the strongest open-source baseline. We also introduce ConfArena, an audience-oriented evaluation framework that simulates a conference room and assesses presentations slide by slide. ConfArena matches human system rankings and detects injected presentation problems, including falsified numbers, degraded figures, dropped slides, and shuffled slide order.

AI.tldr: 提出SlideLab——一种免训练多智能体框架，可从科研论文生成科学演示文稿，通过叙事规划与多智能体协作迭代精炼幻灯片；在人类偏好盲测中以约1/4推理token超越最强开源基线，并配套提出面向听众的评估框架ConfArena。
AI.motivation: 科学演示不仅是论文的摘要，还需具备连贯叙事、清晰表达主旨并帮助听众跟进；现有系统在演示生成与评估两方面均存在不足。
AI.method: SlideLab先规划演示叙事，再通过内容规划、视觉生成、版面精炼与事实核验等智能体构建并迭代优化共享幻灯片；同时提出ConfArena，模拟会议室场景并逐页评估演示。
AI.result: 在人类偏好盲测中，SlideLab在77%的论文上优于开源与商业系统，且推理token用量约为最强开源基线的四分之一；ConfArena与人类系统排序一致，并能检测伪造数字、退化图像、删减幻灯片与幻灯片乱序等注入问题。
AI.conclusion: SlideLab以较低推理成本实现高质量科学演示生成，ConfArena提供了与人类判断一致且可检测演示问题的评估手段，二者共同推进了科学演示自动生成与评估。

title: A Generative AI Integrated Multimodal Framework for Low-Latency Multi-Camera Person Re-Identification
comment: Presented at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence (IRAI)
summary: Person re-identification (ReID) is essential for multi-camera surveillance and tracking, yet remains difficult due to viewpoint and illumination changes, occlusion, background clutter, and low resolution imagery. We propose a generative AI integrated multimodal ReID framework designed explicitly for robustness under missing cues and low latency deployment. The key idea is a cost aware early-exit cascade that prioritizes inexpensive, high confidence evidence and only triggers expensive modalities for ambiguous cases. Our system integrates (i) global visual embeddings from segmented person regions, (ii) automatically generated fine grained semantic attribute descriptions generated by vision-language models (VLMs), and (iii) optional facial embeddings when face observations are reliable. To optimize the balance between accuracy and latency, we use a cost aware early-exit cascade instead of fusing all modalities. Specifically, we first inspect the top-k retrieval results to determine whether the query is unambiguous. If the best match is clearly separated from the remaining candidates, we stop early and return the result to minimize latency; in ambiguous cases, we keep multiple hypotheses and invoke additional modalities (face/semantic) with adaptive reliability weighting to refine the decision. We report person re-identification performance using mAP and Rank-1 accuracy on the Market-1501 and DukeMTMC-reID benchmarks. The proposed adaptive early-exit cascade resolves 60.7% of DukeMTMC-reID queries and 68.4% of Market-1501 queries without invoking semantic reasoning, reducing computational overhead while maintaining competitive retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成式AI驱动的多模态行人重识别框架，核心是代价感知的早退级联策略，在模糊查询时才调用昂贵模态，兼顾鲁棒性与低延迟。
AI.motivation: 行人重识别在视角与光照变化、遮挡、背景杂乱、低分辨率等条件下仍很困难，且多模态融合通常带来高计算开销，需要一种在缺失线索下鲁棒、同时低延迟的部署方案。
AI.method: 整合三类证据：(i) 分割后行人区域的全局视觉嵌入；(ii) 由视觉语言模型（VLM）自动生成的细粒度语义属性描述；(iii) 在面部观测可靠时可选的面部嵌入。采用代价感知早退级联替代全模态融合：先检查top-k检索结果判断查询是否无歧义，若最佳匹配与其余候选明显分离则提前停止返回结果；若存在歧义则保留多个假设，并以自适应可靠性加权调用面部/语义模态进一步精化。
AI.result: 在Market-1501与DukeMTMC-reID基准上以mAP和Rank-1评估。自适应早退级联在未调用语义推理的情况下即解决了DukeMTMC-reID 60.7%、Market-1501 68.4%的查询，降低了计算开销并保持有竞争力的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于置信度分离度的早退级联可在保证检索性能的同时显著减少昂贵模态调用，实现多模态行人重识别的精度-延迟权衡，适合低延迟部署。

title: Lightweight Generalized DeepFake Face Detection with WAVIE: Wavelet Augmented Vision Intermediate Embeddings
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC) 2026
summary: Deepfake detection systems often exhibit significant performance degradation when deployed on unseen manipulation methods, limiting their reliability in real-world multimedia environments. This lack of generalization poses critical challenges for misinformation mitigation, digital forensics, and human-centric AI systems. Existing detectors perform well on the forgery methods they are trained on, but their accuracy drops sharply on unseen pipelines. To bridge this generalization gap, we propose WAVIE (Wavelet Augmented Vision Intermediate Embeddings), an end-to-end architecture that combines complementary spatial and frequency cues on top of a frozen CLIP backbone. WAVIE projects intermediate transformer embeddings through a lightweight learnable module, applies a three-level Daubechies-6 (db6) discrete wavelet transform (DWT), refines the low-frequency branch while preserving the high-frequency branch, reconstructs the feature via inverse DWT, and performs classification. Trained only on FaceForensics++, WAVIE achieves AUROC = 0.852 on Celeb-DF-v1, 0.852 on Celeb-DF-v2 and 0.831 on WildDeepFake (WDF) at the frame level, outperforming several state-of-the-art generalization baselines. Extensive ablation studies confirm the importance of both the wavelet module and the intermediate-feature aggregation for cross-dataset performance, highlighting the necessity of jointly leveraging spatial and frequency domains. These results position WAVIE as a strong baseline for deepfake detection in the wild.

AI.tldr: 提出WAVIE，一种基于冻结CLIP主干、融合空间与频域线索的端到端深度伪造检测架构，通过小波变换增强中间嵌入以提升跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器在同源伪造方法上表现良好，但部署到未见过的伪造管线时准确率急剧下降，泛化能力不足，制约了其在实际多媒体环境中的可靠性，给虚假信息治理、数字取证和以人为中心的AI系统带来挑战。
AI.method: WAVIE以冻结的CLIP为主干，通过轻量可学习模块投影中间Transformer嵌入，施加三级Daubechies-6(db6)离散小波变换，对低频分支进行细化并保留高频分支，经逆小波变换重建特征后进行分类。
AI.result: 仅在FaceForensics++上训练时，WAVIE在帧级别取得AUROC：Celeb-DF-v1为0.852，Celeb-DF-v2为0.852，WildDeepFake为0.831，优于多种最先进的泛化基线。消融实验证实小波模块与中间特征聚合对跨数据集性能均至关重要。
AI.conclusion: WAVIE通过联合利用空间与频域信息有效缩小泛化差距，可作为野外深度伪造检测的强基线。

title: Context-Aware Mutual Learning for Blind Image Inpainting and Beyond
comment: Published in Expert Systems with Applications 268 (2025), Article 126224
summary: Blind image inpainting, aiming to recover contaminated images in the case of unknown masks, is a challenging task. Motivated by the perspective of human vision and knowledge, blind image inpainting can be decomposed into two stages: mask estimation and image inpainting based on the estimated mask. The two-stage idea exhibits evident advantages in enhancing inpainting quality and augmenting the generalization capability of unknown real-world contamination by explicitly employing the estimated mask for image inpainting compared to one-stage scheme. This two-stage idea has also been intuitively implemented. However, existing two-stage methods excessively emphasize the unilateral relationship of mask estimation to image inpainting, and may overlook the mutual relations between them. Specifically, mask estimation can provide more contextual semantics for image inpainting to strengthen the understanding of semantics, and image inpainting can offer more contextual details (e.g., textures and edges) for mask estimation to improve the learning of details. In this work, we propose a novel Context-Aware Mutual Learning (CAML) framework for blind image inpainting that joints mask estimation and image inpainting to mutually exploit contextual information. In the CAML framework, we design the Inpainting-Guided Context-Mutual (IGCM) learner to acquire the complementary contextual details from image inpainting for assisting mask estimation, and the Estimation-Guided Context-Mutual (EGCM) learner to strengthen the understanding of contextual semantics from mask estimation for assisting image inpainting. Ablation studies validate the efficacy of our CAML. Extensive experiments show that our CAML achieves state-of-the-art performance on both blind image inpainting and additional vision tasks, i.e., snow removal, shadow removal, and watermark removal, indicating its superiority.

AI.tldr: 提出Context-Aware Mutual Learning (CAML)框架，通过掩码估计与图像修复的双向互学习，实现盲图像修复的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 盲图像修复在未知掩码下极具挑战。将任务分解为掩码估计与基于掩码的图像修复两阶段，相比单阶段能显著提升修复质量并增强对未知真实污染的泛化能力。但现有两阶段方法过度强调掩码估计对图像修复的单向作用，忽视了二者的相互促进：掩码估计提供上下文语义，图像修复提供纹理、边缘等上下文细节。
AI.method: 提出CAML框架，联合掩码估计与图像修复以互相利用上下文信息。包含两个学习器：Inpainting-Guided Context-Mutual (IGCM) learner从图像修复中获取互补的上下文细节以辅助掩码估计；Estimation-Guided Context-Mutual (EGCM) learner从掩码估计中强化上下文语义理解以辅助图像修复。
AI.result: 消融实验验证了CAML各模块的有效性。大量实验表明CAML在盲图像修复及雪去除、阴影去除、水印去除等附加视觉任务上均达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模掩码估计与图像修复的双向互学习关系，CAML充分利用上下文信息，提升了盲图像修复质量与泛化能力，并可推广至其他视觉修复任务。

title: From Visual Attribution to Clinical Reasoning: Explainable Parkinson's Disease Screening from Hand-Drawn Patterns
summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) manifests early neuromotor impairments that become observable in controlled hand-drawn patterns such as spirals and meanders, where tremor-induced oscillations, stroke irregularity, and curvature instability reflect underlying motor degradation. In this work, we present an explainable framework for PD screening from offline hand-drawn patterns that integrates discriminative visual modeling with clinically grounded reasoning. The predictive model captures distributed structural distortions and fine-grained texture variations. It is evaluated under subject-disjoint protocols to ensure reliable generalization. To move beyond black-box classification, we introduce a multi-stage explainability pipeline that combines visual attribution with structured symptom abstraction. Salient regions are identified using attention- and gradient-based localization, followed by extraction of clinically meaningful motor descriptors quantifying contour roughness, curvature irregularity, stroke variability, and tremor-frequency energy. These descriptors are subsequently translated into coherent clinical rationales through a language-based reasoning module, linking model evidence to established PD symptomatology. By bridging visual attribution and clinical interpretation, the proposed framework advances interpretable document intelligence for neurological screening using hand-drawn patterns. Experimental results on publicly available Parkinson's disease handwriting datasets demonstrate competitive predictive performance and clinically consistent explanations.

AI.tldr: 提出一个可解释框架，从离线手绘图案（螺旋、回纹）中筛查帕金森病，将判别式视觉建模与临床推理结合，通过多阶段解释流程将视觉归因转化为临床症状描述。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病早期神经运动损伤可在螺旋、回纹等受控手绘图案中显现，表现为震颤振荡、笔画不规则和曲率不稳定。现有方法多为黑箱分类，缺乏临床可解释性，难以支撑神经筛查的实际应用。
AI.method: 1）判别式视觉模型捕捉分布式结构畸变与细粒度纹理变化；2）在受试者不相交（subject-disjoint）协议下评估以保证泛化性；3）多阶段可解释流水线：用注意力与梯度定位显著区域，提取临床运动描述符（轮廓粗糙度、曲率不规则性、笔画变异性、震颤频段能量），再经语言推理模块转化为连贯的临床解释理由。
AI.result: 在公开帕金森病手写数据集上取得有竞争力的预测性能，并给出一致的、符合临床的解释。
AI.conclusion: 通过衔接视觉归因与临床解读，该框架推动了面向神经筛查的可解释文档智能，为基于手绘图案的帕金森病筛查提供可解释支持。

title: NeuroActiSep: Detecting Factual Hallucinations from Feed-Forward Neurons in a Single Pass
summary: Hallucination in large language models reduces their reliability and slows adoption. Various white-box studies have used internal representations to detect patterns of truthfulness and factuality. A less-studied approach is to identify feed-forward neurons correlated with hallucination. We propose a method to rank feed-forward neurons at the final prompt token using a custom neuron selection dataset. We transfer the selected neuron identities to train hallucination classifiers on other factual question answering datasets. Our work provides empirical evidence that probes trained using the features from the selected neurons perform on par with probes trained on internal states. We also analyze the distribution of selected neurons and the effect of layer depth on detection performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于自定义神经元选择数据集、在最后一个提示token处对前馈神经元进行排序的方法，将选出的神经元身份迁移到其他事实问答数据集上训练幻觉分类器。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的幻觉降低其可靠性并阻碍应用落地。已有白盒研究多利用内部表示检测真实性与事实性模式，而"识别与幻觉相关的前馈神经元"这一方向研究较少。
AI.method: 构建自定义神经元选择数据集，在最后一个提示token处对前馈神经元进行排序打分以筛选与幻觉相关的神经元；随后将所选神经元的身份迁移到其他事实问答数据集上，用以训练幻觉分类器（探针）。
AI.result: 实证表明，使用所选神经元特征训练的探针，其性能与基于模型内部状态训练的探针相当；并进一步分析了所选神经元的分布以及层深度对检测性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过前馈神经元选择即可获得与内部状态探针相当的幻觉检测能力，为从神经元层面理解与检测幻觉提供了经验证据，并揭示了神经元分布与层深度的作用。

title: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video
comment: Project page: https://alaya-lab.github.io/AlayaVista
summary: Interactive video world models must maintain broad scene context under camera motion while producing high-fidelity observations with low latency. Existing approaches face a representation trade-off: perspective models operate on local views and must preserve off-screen content over long rollouts, whereas broader spatial coverage is typically obtained by synthesizing full-sphere videos or constructing explicit 3D representations. Motivated by the complementary roles of global context and selective local acuity in visual perception, we present AlayaVista, a camera-controllable streaming video world model that decouples panoramic world evolution from perspective observation synthesis. Given a single perspective image, AlayaVista constructs a 360-degree scene prior using a pretrained panorama expansion model and then evolves the scene as a camera-conditioned panoramic latent state. A latent viewport renderer maps this state to the requested perspective video latents, while a perspective refiner restores details, suppresses artifacts, and performs super-resolution. To support efficient streaming, we adapt the panoramic generator to chunk-autoregressive generation and distill both panoramic generation and perspective refinement into few-step processes. To provide the supervision required by this design, we construct MUGEN, a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset containing 1,318 hours of videos at resolutions of at least 4K, together with rich semantic and geometric annotations.

AI.tldr: AlayaVista 提出一种解耦全景世界演化与透视观察合成的相机可控流式视频世界模型，实现长时程一致、高保真、低延迟的交互式视频生成。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需在相机运动下保持广阔场景上下文，同时生成高保真、低延迟的观察。现有方法存在表征权衡：透视模型仅处理局部视图，长时 rollout 需保存屏幕外内容；而广域空间覆盖通常依赖合成全球面视频或构建显式 3D 表征。作者受视觉感知中全局上下文与选择性局部锐度互补的启发，提出解耦方案。
AI.method: 给定单张透视图像，先用预训练全景扩展模型构建 360 度场景先验，并将场景演化为相机条件驱动的全景隐状态；通过隐空间视口渲染器将该状态映射为所需透视视频隐表示，再由透视精修器恢复细节、抑制伪影并执行超分。为支持高效流式生成，将全景生成器改造为分块自回归生成，并把全景生成与透视精修蒸馏为少步过程。同时构建 MUGEN 大规模真实世界全景视频数据集（1,318 小时、至少 4K、含丰富语义与几何标注）以提供监督。
AI.result: 构建了 MUGEN 数据集，包含 1,318 小时视频，分辨率至少 4K，并配有丰富的语义和几何标注。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过解耦全景世界演化与透视观察合成，兼顾全局上下文与局部高保真，并借助分块自回归与少步蒸馏实现低延迟流式生成，为相机可控视频世界模型提供了新范式。

title: DynEoMT: Learning Object Dynamicity from Online Segmentation Queries
comment: Submitted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)
summary: Video segmentation models recognize and track objects over time, but they do not indicate whether each segmented region moves independently of the observing camera. This dynamicity attribute cannot be inferred from semantics alone and is confounded by camera ego-motion. We introduce \method, an online framework that augments query-based video segmentation with region-level dynamicity prediction. It jointly produces the original segmentation outputs and a dynamic or static state for each predicted region. At inference, DynEoMT uses only the current frame and propagated queries, without optical flow, depth, camera pose, previous RGB frames, or feature maps. Because established video segmentation benchmarks do not annotate this attribute, we also introduce a class-agnostic offline supervision pipeline using camera-compensated optical flow and confidence-aware temporal filtering. Across VIPSeg, OVIS, YouTube-VIS 2022, and VSPW, DynEoMT achieves balanced accuracies of 84.3, 68.0, 68.6, and 87.6, respectively, while largely preserving segmentation performance. These results show that segmentation-region dynamicity can be learned from propagated queries, enabling its online prediction without a dedicated motion-processing pipeline at inference. The complete code will be released as open source to enable full reproduction of the method and experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出DynEoMT，一个在线的查询式视频分割框架，在输出分割结果的同时为每个区域预测"动态/静态"属性，无需光流、深度、相机位姿等运动信息。
AI.motivation: 现有视频分割模型能识别和跟踪目标，但不判断各分割区域是否相对观察相机独立运动。该动态性属性无法仅从语义推断，且受相机自运动干扰；同时现有基准缺乏该属性标注。
AI.method: DynEoMT在查询式视频分割基础上扩展区域级动态性预测，联合输出原始分割结果与每个区域动态/静态状态；推理时仅使用当前帧和传播的查询，不依赖光流、深度、相机位姿、历史RGB帧或特征图。另提出类别无关的离线监督流程，基于相机补偿光流与置信度感知的时间滤波生成监督信号。
AI.result: 在VIPSeg、OVIS、YouTube-VIS 2022、VSPW上分别取得84.3、68.0、68.6、87.6的平衡准确率，同时基本保持原有分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 分割区域的动态性可从传播查询中学习，从而实现在线预测，推理阶段无需专用运动处理流程。代码将开源以支持复现。

title: PRI-Net: A Lightweight Multimodal Framework for 3D UAV Localization
comment: Accepted by IEEE PIMRC 2026
summary: Accurate 3D localization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains challenging for existing multimodal approaches due to sparse LiDAR geometry, modality-imbalanced fusion, and redundant feature transmission over constrained edge-to-server links. To address these limitations, we propose PRI-Net, an efficient and lightweight multimodal fusion framework for UAV localization that integrates point cloud splatting, residual attention fusion, and an information bottleneck. Specifically, a 3D point cloud splatting (3DPCS) strategy is introduced to transform sparse LiDAR observations into geometrically consistent dense depth maps. A residual attention fusion (RAF) module is then designed to alleviate modal bias by using an image branch for coarse estimation and a gated fusion branch for refinement. In addition, a multimodal information bottleneck (MIB) module compacts features by filtering task-irrelevant redundancy. Experiments show that PRI-Net achieves high localization accuracy with lightweight architectures, while reducing feature dimensionality and improving edge-to-server UAV sensing efficiency and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出PRI-Net轻量多模态融合框架，用于无人机3D定位，集成点云溅射、残差注意力融合与信息瓶颈，兼顾精度、轻量化与边缘传输效率。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机多模态3D定位方法受限于三点：LiDAR点云几何稀疏、模态融合不均衡（模态偏置）、以及边缘到服务器链路受限下的冗余特征传输。因此需要一种高效轻量、融合均衡且传输紧凑的方案。
AI.method: PRI-Net包含三个核心模块：1）3D点云溅射（3DPCS）策略，将稀疏LiDAR观测转换为几何一致的稠密深度图；2）残差注意力融合（RAF）模块，用图像分支做粗估计、门控融合分支做细化，以缓解模态偏置；3）多模态信息瓶颈（MIB）模块，通过过滤任务无关冗余来压缩特征。
AI.result: 实验表明，PRI-Net以轻量架构实现了较高的定位精度，同时降低了特征维度，并提升了无人机边缘到服务器感知的效率与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过点云稠密化、注意力门控融合与信息瓶颈压缩的组合设计，PRI-Net在精度、模型轻量化和传输效率之间取得了良好平衡，适用于受限链路下的无人机多模态3D定位。

title: PuzzleMate: Benchmarking MLLMs for Egocentric Puzzle Assistance
summary: Personal AI assistants hold the potential to evolve from digital interfaces into embodied companions capable of guiding users through complex physical activities. For these assistants to become integral to daily life, they must do more than identify objects; they must provide precise, step-by-step instructions that align with a user's real-time progress. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promise in general visual understanding, their ability to deliver grounded, sequential guidance for fine-grained manipulation tasks remains largely unverified. In this paper, we choose the jigsaw puzzle as a strategic testbed for this capability. Unlike general object recognition, puzzle solving demands high-precision spatial reasoning, the ability to distinguish between minute geometric variations, and a rigorous adherence to sequential logic. We investigate this capability through PuzzleMate, a novel framework focused on jigsaw puzzle solving captured through an egocentric viewpoint. We deploy PuzzleMate in a user-in-the-loop study to evaluate how well state-of-the-art MLLMs perceive the current puzzle state and generate actionable next-step instructions. Our analysis reveals seven key bottlenecks that limit their effectiveness. Building on these insights, we propose a benchmark that enables systematic evaluation of MLLMs' reasoning capabilities for puzzle solving. Our findings reveal a substantial performance gap in current models like GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5-Pro; while these MLLMs are highly capable, they struggle to navigate the intricate reasoning and sequential logic essential for jigsaw puzzle assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文以拼图作为测评载体，提出 PuzzleMate 框架与配套基准，检验多模态大模型在细粒度、序列化实体操作指导上的能力。
AI.motivation: 个人AI助手若要从数字界面进化为具身伴侣，必须能提供与用户实时进度对齐的精确分步指导，而非仅做物体识别；而MLLM在细粒度操作任务的落地式序列指导能力尚缺乏验证。
AI.method: 选择拼图作为策略性测试床，因其要求高精度空间推理、微小几何差异辨识与严格序列逻辑；提出 PuzzleMate 框架，以第一人称视角采集拼图过程，并采用 user-in-the-loop 研究评估 SOTA MLLM 对当前拼图状态的感知与下一步指令生成。
AI.result: 分析揭示限制现有模型有效性的七项关键瓶颈；据此构建可系统评估拼图推理能力的基准；GPT-5.2、Gemini-2.5-Pro 等模型表现出显著性能差距，难以完成所需复杂推理与序列逻辑。
AI.conclusion: 当前 MLLM 在拼图辅助这类细粒度序列指导任务上仍能力不足，PuzzleMate 及其基准为评估与改进该能力提供了系统化路径。

title: MCIQA-2K: A Multi-Dimensional Dataset and No-Reference Quality Assessment Benchmark for Colorized Images
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables
summary: Image colorization is an inherently ill-posed task, since a single grayscale image may correspond to multiple plausible colorized results. Consequently, conventional full-reference image quality assessment (IQA) metrics fail to accurately reflect human perceptual preferences for colorized images. In this paper, we present MCIQA-2K, a large-scale multi-dimensional benchmark specifically designed for no-reference quality assessment of colorized images. We construct a dataset containing 2,000 colorized images generated by five representative colorization models, together with human annotations across three perceptual dimensions: color smearing, semantic color misalignment, and global naturalness. Building upon the proposed benchmark, we further introduce MCIQA, a dedicated multi-branch NR-IQA framework for colorized images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MCIQA significantly outperforms existing full-reference and no-reference IQA methods on the proposed benchmark, while also exhibiting competitive generalization capability on several widely-used IQA datasets. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/ARBEZ-ZEBRA/MCIQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向彩色化图像的无参考质量评估基准MCIQA-2K及多分支NR-IQA框架MCIQA，实验表明其显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 图像彩色化本质上是病态问题，单张灰度图可对应多种合理的彩色化结果，因此传统全参考IQA指标难以准确反映人类对彩色化图像的感知偏好。现有研究缺乏针对彩色化图像的多维无参考质量评估基准与方法。
AI.method: 构建MCIQA-2K大规模多维基准数据集，包含由五种代表性彩色化模型生成的2000张彩色化图像，并配有人类在三个感知维度上的标注：颜色涂抹(color smearing)、语义色彩错位(semantic color misalignment)与全局自然度(global naturalness)。在此基础上提出MCIQA，一个专用的多分支无参考IQA框架。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MCIQA在所提基准上显著优于现有的全参考与无参考IQA方法，同时在多个常用IQA数据集上展现出有竞争力的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了彩色化图像无参考质量评估的基准与专用框架，数据集与代码已公开，为后续研究奠定基础。

title: From Hand-Crafted to LLM-Based Variation Operators in Metaheuristics: A Tutorial
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being employed as variation operators in metaheuristics, generating or modifying candidate solutions, heuristics, or programs inside iterative search loops. This shift reframes variation as a model call conditioned on different types of information. We introduce an operator-level framework with two descriptors: (1) the type of prompt-conditioning information at variation time (\texttt{Numeric}, \texttt{Symbolic}, \texttt{Linguistic}), and (2) artifact persistence, identifying what survives the model call (\texttt{Transient}, \texttt{Amortized}, \texttt{Transfer}). The tutorial shows how to classify, build, and select these operators through a worked build template, a method survey, an evidence table, and a cost-aware decision guide.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个算子级别框架，用提示条件信息类型与产物持久性两个描述符，对LLM作为变异算子的元启发式方法进行分类、构建与选择。
AI.motivation: LLM正越来越多地被用作元启发式中的变异算子，在迭代搜索循环内生成或修改候选解、启发式和程序，使变异被重新定义为基于不同类型信息的模型调用。但该方向缺乏统一的概念与选择标准，因此需要一个算子级别框架来指导分类与设计。
AI.method: 提出算子级别框架，包含两个描述符：(1) 变异时的提示条件信息类型，区分为Numeric、Symbolic、Linguistic三类；(2) 产物持久性，即模型调用后保留的内容，区分为Transient、Amortized、Transfer三类。通过构建模板、方法综述、证据表和成本感知决策指南展示如何分类、构建与选择这些算子。
AI.result: 该教程提供了可操作的构建模板、方法综述、证据表与成本感知决策指南，用以指导LLM变异算子的分类、构建与选择。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM变异重新概念化为条件化模型调用，并用提示条件信息类型与产物持久性两维度刻画，可为元启发式中LLM算子的设计、比较与选择提供结构化依据。

title: CGGT: Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer for 3D Parametric Curve Reconstruction
comment: Accepted by SIGGRAPH Asia 2026
summary: Recovering editable 3D parametric curves from 2D images is a fundamental challenge in computer graphics, bridging pixel-based perception and vector-based CAD modeling. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods often rely on dense calibrated views, precomputed 2D edge maps, and costly per-scene optimization, limiting their applicability to casually captured real-world inputs. We propose CGGT, a Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer that directly grounds 3D-consistent 2D curve instances in the image space from sparse, unposed multi-view images. CGGT combines a geometry-aware transformer encoder for multi-view feature learning with a curve-aware masked-attention decoder for cross-view instance association. In a single forward pass, it predicts camera parameters, dense depth maps, and instance-level 2D curve masks, which are then lifted into 3D and refined through a fast parametric optimization stage to recover compact, editable 3D curve primitives. To support structured curve learning, we introduce Wireframe-100K, a large-scale dataset comprising 100,000 CAD models with diverse topologies, realistic multi-view renderings, and accurate parametric curve annotations. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves substantial improvements in both reconstruction accuracy and efficiency, particularly under challenging sparse-view settings and in separating persistent 3D structural edges from view-dependent image edges caused by silhouettes, textures, and appearance variations. Despite being trained solely on synthetic data, CGGT generalizes well to real-world images, demonstrating its potential for practical CAD-style wireframe reconstruction from unconstrained visual inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出CGGT，一种几何感知Transformer，可从稀疏、未标定多视角图像直接重建可编辑3D参数化曲线，并构建Wireframe-100K数据集，实现精度与效率的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 从2D图像恢复可编辑3D参数化曲线是计算机图形学中连接像素感知与矢量CAD建模的基础难题。现有基于NeRF和3DGS的方法依赖密集标定视角、预计算2D边缘图及昂贵的逐场景优化，难以应用于随意采集的真实世界输入。核心技术难点在于将持久性的3D结构边缘与由轮廓、纹理、外观变化引起的视角相关图像边缘相分离。
AI.method: CGGT由几何感知Transformer编码器进行多视角特征学习，配合曲线感知掩码注意力解码器实现跨视角实例关联。单次前向传播即可预测相机参数、稠密深度图和实例级2D曲线掩码，随后将其提升到3D，并通过快速参数化优化阶段精炼为紧凑、可编辑的3D曲线基元。此外构建Wireframe-100K数据集，含100,000个CAD模型及多视角渲染与精确参数化曲线标注。
AI.result: 在重建精度与效率上均取得显著提升，尤其在稀疏视角设置下，以及区分持久3D结构边缘与视角相关图像边缘方面表现突出。尽管仅用合成数据训练，CGGT在真实图像上仍具备良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CGGT展示了从无约束视觉输入进行实用化CAD风格线框重建的潜力。

title: Selective Tool Use for Agentic Change Visual Question Answering in Remote Sensing
summary: Change visual question answering (Change VQA) requires understanding semantic changes across bi-temporal remote sensing images. Although vision language models (VLMs) have shown promising performance on this task, they remain unreliable when answering questions that require explicit transition statistics, area measurements, or spatial information. To address this limitation, we propose a selective tool use framework in which a single VLM either answers directly or invokes a deterministic change analysis tool to obtain question specific evidence. Specifically, the selected tool operates on bi-temporal semantic maps and returns a structured observation, which the same VLM uses to generate its final answer. To support this framework, we construct a tool augmented extension of CDVQA covering eight question families and three tools for transition, spatial, and temporal analysis. Tool use supervision and observations are derived automatically from the original semantic annotations, without additional manual labeling. We then adapt Qwen3.5-4B using Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to jointly learn direct answering, tool invocation, and evidence conditioned answering. Experiments on 7,164 test questions show that selective tool use with reference semantic maps improves overall accuracy from 73.77% to 88.79% and average family accuracy from 69.11% to 89.65%. When the semantic maps are predicted automatically, the framework achieves 77.47% overall accuracy and 75.06% average family accuracy. These results demonstrate the benefit of question-specific semantic evidence for Change VQA, while highlighting the influence of semantic prediction quality on the resulting performance. Code and tool-augmented annotations will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yakoubbazi/ToolChangeVQA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出选择性工具使用框架，让单个VLM在Change VQA任务中直接回答或调用确定性变化分析工具，并构建了工具增强的CDVQA扩展数据集，通过LoRA微调Qwen3.5-4B。使用参考语义图时整体准确率从73.77%提升至88.79%，使用预测语义图时为77.47%。
AI.motivation: Change VQA需要理解双时相遥感影像中的语义变化，而现有VLM在涉及显式转移统计、面积测量或空间信息的问题上表现不可靠。作者希望借助确定性的变化分析工具，为需要精确统计和空间证据的问题提供针对性支持。
AI.method: 提出选择性工具使用框架：单个VLM可选择直接回答，或调用确定性的变化分析工具。工具在双时相语义图上运行，返回结构化观测结果，再由同一VLM据此生成最终答案。据此构建了工具增强版CDVQA扩展集，涵盖八类问题族及转移、空间、时序三类工具，工具使用监督与观测均由原始语义标注自动派生，无需额外人工标注。随后用LoRA适配Qwen3.5-4B，联合学习直接回答、工具调用与证据条件化回答。
AI.result: 在7,164个测试问题上，使用参考语义图的选择性工具使用将整体准确率从73.77%提升至88.79%，平均问题族准确率从69.11%提升至89.65%；当语义图由模型自动预测时，整体准确率为77.47%，平均问题族准确率为75.06%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明了问题特定的语义证据对Change VQA的价值，同时凸显了语义预测质量对最终性能的重要影响。代码与工具增强标注将开源。

title: Theseus in the Graph: Towards Traceable Multi-Hop Graph Navigation
comment: 30 pages, 1 figure,
summary: Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) tasks require models to assemble relational evidence along paths in a KG to answer natural-language questions. However, existing KGQA systems typically focus on predicting the final answer without explicitly modeling or validating the intermediate reasoning steps, obscuring whether the correct answers arise from faithful multi-hop reasoning. To address this limitation, we re-frame multi-hop KGQA as a question-conditioned graph navigation problem. We refer to this formulation as THESEUS - Traceable Hop-wise Evidence SEarch in a Unified Semantics. In this setting, an agent receives a KG, a question, and a topic entity, and traverses a sequence of relations towards the answer, making the reasoning path explicit. To systematically study this formulation, we provide three key contributions. (i) We augment the existing KINSHIP and MQuAKE resources into navigation-ready KGQA datasets with annotated evidence paths and paraphrased questions. (ii) We design evaluation protocols to measure path fidelity, robustness to linguistic variation, and performance across multi-hop and multi-answer questions. (iii) We adapt established path-based KG completion agents - MINERVA, MultiHopKG, and SQUIRE - to operate on full question embeddings rather than symbolic single-relation queries, enabling their trajectories to be guided by natural-language semantics. Together, these contributions advance KGQA research toward systems where traceability is fundamental: answers are accompanied by explicit reasoning paths whose agreement with reference evidence can be systematically evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文将多跳知识图谱问答（KGQA）重构为"问题条件下的图导航问题"（THESEUS），通过为KINSHIP和MQuAKE构建带证据路径标注的导航式数据集、设计路径保真度等评估协议，并将MINERVA、MultiHopKG、SQUIRE适配为基于完整问题嵌入的导航智能体，使推理路径显式可追踪、可评估。
AI.motivation: 现有KGQA系统通常只预测最终答案，而不显式建模或验证中间推理步骤，导致无法判断正确答案是否源于忠实的多跳推理，即缺乏可追踪性（traceability）。
AI.method: 将多跳KGQA重新表述为问题条件下的图导航问题（THESEUS）：智能体接收知识图谱、问题和主题实体，沿关系序列逐步遍历至答案，使推理路径显式化。具体包括三项工作：(i) 将KINSHIP与MQuAKE资源扩展为带证据路径标注和问题改写的导航式KGQA数据集；(ii) 设计评估协议以衡量路径保真度、对语言变化的鲁棒性，以及在多跳与多答案问题上的表现；(iii) 将MINERVA、MultiHopKG、SQUIRE等基于路径的KG补全智能体改造为以完整问题嵌入（而非符号化单关系查询）为输入，使其轨迹受自然语言语义引导。
AI.result: 构建了导航式KGQA数据集与评估协议，并成功将三种路径式KG补全智能体适配为问题嵌入驱动，从而能够系统性评估答案与参考证据路径的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动KGQA研究向"以可追踪性为核心"的方向发展：系统输出答案时附带显式推理路径，且该路径与参考证据的一致性可被系统化评估。

title: Parameter-Efficient Quantum NLP for Paraphrase Detection: Performance, Robustness, and Entanglement
summary: Rigorous empirical validation of quantum machine learning on natural language tasks remains scarce. We evaluate a 10-qubit hybrid quantum-classical variational circuit (2,148 parameters) for paraphrase detection across three benchmarks: MRPC, Quora Question Pairs (QQP), and adversarial PAWS. On QQP (n = 10 seeds), the circuit achieves 75.53% +/- 0.75%. accuracy, statistically outperforming parameter-matched classical baselines (DeepMLP: p = 0.015, Cohen's d = 1.20; F1: p < 0.001, d = 2.32) and surpassing DistilBERT-4bit with 31,191 fewer parameters. On MRPC the optimal 2-layer variant reaches 92% of BERT-base accuracy at 54,000 lower parameter cost. Circuit depth analysis reveals a dataset-depth scaling effect; entanglement analysis via the Meyer-Wallach measure identifies multi-qubit entanglement as the primary performance driver (r = 0.85 across four variants). Adversarial evaluation on PAWS reveals emergent robustness: 98.2% recall versus 81.6% classical (+16.6 pp, d = 1.24, p < 0.001), without adversarial training. These results constitute the first systematic parameter-matched multi-benchmark empirical validation of hybrid variational circuits for NLP. All results are from classical simulation; hardware validation is future work.

AI.tldr: 该论文对10量子比特混合量子-经典变分电路（2148参数）在改写句检测任务上进行了首个系统性、参数匹配的多基准实证验证。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习在自然语言任务上的严格实证验证仍然稀缺，已有研究普遍缺乏参数匹配的公平对比、多基准评估以及与经典模型的统计显著性检验。
AI.method: 构建并评估一个10量子比特混合量子-经典变分电路（2148个参数），在MRPC、Quora Question Pairs（QQP）与对抗性PAWS三个基准上进行改写句检测；在QQP上使用10个随机种子，与参数匹配的经典基线（DeepMLP）及DistilBERT-4bit比较；分析电路深度-数据集缩放效应，并用Meyer-Wallach度规量化纠缠；在PAWS上进行对抗评估（无对抗训练）。
AI.result: QQP上达到75.53% ± 0.75%准确率，统计上优于参数匹配的经典基线（准确率p = 0.015，Cohen's d = 1.20；F1：p < 0.001，d = 2.32），并以少31,191个参数超过DistilBERT-4bit；MRPC上最优2层变体以少54,000参数达到BERT-base准确率的92%；多量子比特纠缠是主要性能驱动因素（四变体间r = 0.85）；PAWS上召回率98.2%对经典81.6%（+16.6个百分点，d = 1.24，p < 0.001），表现出涌现鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作构成混合变分电路用于NLP的首个系统性参数匹配多基准实证验证，表明量子电路在参数效率与对抗鲁棒性上具潜力；但所有结果均来自经典模拟，硬件验证为未来工作。

title: Sharing standardized image-derived data in computational pathology using DICOM
comment: Daniela P. Schacherer, Christopher P. Bridge: contributed equally
summary: Development and evaluation of computational pathology methods require access to large and diverse datasets. Over the past decade, various initiatives invested significantly into collecting, centralizing, and sharing pathology imaging data. In contrast, sharing of image-derived data such as region-of-interest delineations or segmentation masks is less well developed. In this work, we describe our approach to encoding and sharing image-derived pathology data in a standardized manner within the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Imaging Data Commons (IDC), a platform that hosts and provides public access to de-identified radiology and pathology data. The IDC relies on the Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) standard for data harmonization, yet the adoption of DICOM for pathology image-derived content has remained largely unexplored until now. Here, we present five representative datasets harmonized by conversion from their original representations into DICOM and shared publicly in the IDC. We demonstrate the benefits of this harmonization, describe contributions to critical open-source tooling, and discuss technical considerations relevant to broader adoption of DICOM for pathology image-derived data.

AI.tldr: 该文介绍在NCI影像数据共享平台IDC中，将病理图像衍生数据（如ROI标注、分割掩膜）按DICOM标准编码并公开共享的方法，并通过五个代表性数据集展示其可行性与优势。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学方法的开发与评估需要大规模、多样化数据集。过去十年，业界在病理成像原始数据的采集、集中与共享上投入显著，但图像衍生数据（如感兴趣区勾画、分割掩膜）的共享相对滞后，缺乏标准化方式。
AI.method: 依托美国国家癌症研究所（NCI）影像数据共享平台IDC，采用DICOM标准对数据进行统一化处理；将五个代表性数据集从其原始表示转换为DICOM格式，在IDC中公开共享，并对相关开源工具进行贡献。
AI.result: 展示了五个代表性数据集经转换为DICOM后成功统一化并公开共享；验证了该统一化方式的优势，同时说明了在病理图像衍生数据中更广泛采用DICOM所需考虑的技术问题。
AI.conclusion: DICOM可用于病理图像衍生数据的标准化编码与共享，具有推广价值；其在病理领域的应用此前尚未充分探索，本文为其更广泛采用提供了实践依据与工具支持。

title: Neyshekar: An Open Persian Read-Speech Corpus for Automatic Speech Recognition
comment: 24 pages, 6 figures; dataset and code available at https://github.com/amirivojdan/neyshekar
summary: Neyshekar is presented as an open Persian read-speech corpus designed for coverage of both formal and informal language, named entities, and longer utterances. In version 6, 62,279 validated recordings totalling 99.02 hours are provided from 190 contributors, with 34,541 distinct recorded prompts. The prompt pool was assembled from human-written material, contextualised homographs, and reviewed language-model-generated text. Text entries were normalised with the shekar library, which supports both formal and informal Persian, and every submitted recording was reviewed against a common validation rubric. About 24% of released clips are classified as informal by an automatic classifier; these register labels are not human-validated. Item-level rater labels are provided for reproducible agreement estimation, opaque per-clip contributor identifiers make the speaker-disjoint partitioning auditable and support contributor-clustered uncertainty estimates, and a text-disjoint test subset is included for evaluation beyond previously seen prompts. Per-contributor recording load and reference-free signal quality are characterised for every released clip. Corpus characteristics are compared with Persian Common Voice under shared processing. Utility is assessed through two ASR architectures, three optimisation seeds, WER and CER, and independent evaluation on the public PSRB sample. Against duration-matched Common Voice training at approximately 32 hours, in-domain WER is reduced by 9.5 points for Whisper and 11.6 points for XLS-R, and by approximately eight points for both architectures on the independent PSRB sample. Transfer and mixture benefits are not consistently observed across architectures and training budgets. The corpus is released under CC0; code and data are made available through the project repository at https://github.com/amirivojdan/neyshekar.

AI.tldr: Neyshekar是一个覆盖正式与非正式波斯语的开源朗读语音语料库（v6：62,279条录音、99.02小时、190位贡献者），提供可审计的说话人/文本划分与验证标签，并在ASR实验中相较时长匹配的Common Voice显著降低WER。
AI.motivation: 波斯语缺乏同时覆盖正式/非正式语体、命名实体与长句的开源朗读语音资源；现有语料（如Persian Common Voice）在语体覆盖、划分可审计性与评估协议上存在不足，难以支撑可复现的ASR评测。
AI.method: （1）语料构建：提示池由人工撰写文本、语境化同形异义词及经审核的语言模型生成文本组成，文本经shekar库归一化以支持正式与非正式波斯语；每条录音按统一验证准则审核。（2）数据标注：提供条目级评分者标签用于一致性估计，使用不透明贡献者ID实现可审计的说话人不相交划分并支持贡献者聚类不确定性估计，另设文本不相交测试子集。（3）特性刻画：对每条发布音频统计贡献者录音负载与无参考信号质量，并在统一处理流程下与Persian Common Voice对比；约24%片段由自动分类器标为非正式（该语体标签未经人工验证）。（4）效用评估：采用两种ASR架构（Whisper、XLS-R）、三个优化随机种子，以WER与CER为指标，并在公开PSRB样本上独立评测，与约32小时时长匹配的Common Voice训练基线对比。
AI.result: 在约32小时时长匹配训练下，域内WER相对Common Voice基线：Whisper降低9.5个百分点，XLS-R降低11.6个百分点；在独立PSRB样本上两种架构均降低约8个百分点。跨架构与不同训练预算下，迁移与混合训练的增益并不一致。
AI.conclusion: Neyshekar提供了大规模、语体覆盖广、划分与标签可审计的波斯语朗读语音资源，并在受控实验中验证了其相对Common Voice的ASR性能优势；语料以CC0协议发布，代码与数据见https://github.com/amirivojdan/neyshekar。语体标签未经人工验证、迁移/混合收益不稳定等限制亦被明确指出。

title: SignTrace: Describe a Sign, Find the Word
comment: Includes reproducibility data and method documentation
summary: Identifying an unfamiliar sign is difficult when a learner remembers its movement but does not know its meaning or formal feature codes. SignTrace addresses this longstanding reverse-lookup problem through natural-language access to a Chinese sign-language dictionary. The system integrates LLM-based dictionary enrichment, action extraction, dictionary-style rewriting, seven-channel retrieval, and candidate reranking over 6,699 entries. It has been deployed for user trials and has received positive informal feedback. Evaluation on a dictionary-derived benchmark of 500 movement-description queries yields 94.0% Hit@1, 97.4% Hit@9, and a mean reciprocal rank of 0.9540. Reranking increases Hit@1 from 71.8% to 94.0%, while component analyses show the contribution of enriched entry descriptions. Median query-processing time is 13.37 seconds with six concurrent queries. By connecting everyday movement descriptions to documented signs and meanings, SignTrace provides a practical tool for identifying unfamiliar signs. Dictionary-derived wording and prior selection within the benchmark limit generalization to descriptions independently produced by users.

AI.tldr: SignTrace 通过自然语言访问中文手语词典，解决了"记得动作但不知含义"的反向查询难题，在 6,699 条词条上实现 94.0% Hit@1。
AI.motivation: 学习者常记得某个手势的动作，却不清楚其含义或正式特征编码，导致无法在传统词典中检索，这一反向查询问题长期存在。
AI.method: 系统集成基于 LLM 的词典增强、动作抽取、词典风格改写、七通道检索与候选重排序，覆盖 6,699 条词条。
AI.result: 在 500 条词典衍生动作描述基准上取得 94.0% Hit@1、97.4% Hit@9，MRR 为 0.9540；重排序将 Hit@1 从 71.8% 提升至 94.0%；六路并发下查询处理中位耗时为 13.37 秒。
AI.conclusion: SignTrace 将日常动作描述与规范手语词条及释义连接，是识别陌生手语的实用工具；但基准源自词典措辞且含先验选择，泛化到用户独立生成的描述仍受限。

title: Small Object Detection in Drone Aerial Imagery with LAF-YOLOv10
summary: General-purpose object detectors lose accuracy on UAV footage, where targets span only a handful of pixels and onboard compute is limited. Prior work composes independently-validated architectural techniques into one detector, assuming gains reported in isolation transfer once combined. We stress-test that assumption directly. LAF-YOLOv10 integrates four techniques into YOLOv10n: a Partial Convolution C2f (PC-C2f) backbone block, an Attention-Guided Feature Pyramid Network (AG-FPN), a P2 detection head replacing the large-object P5 head, and Wise-IoU v3 regression, asking whether their combined effect matches what each contributes alone. We train LAF-YOLOv10 three times (seeds 42, 123, 256) on VisDrone-DET2019, benchmark against unmodified YOLOv10n, and use TIDE error decomposition, per-category breakdown, per-component ablation, attention/loss comparisons, zero-shot transfer to UAVDT, and held-out/test-dev evaluation to localize where the combination succeeds or fails. Composability does not hold here. LAF-YOLOv10 reaches 24.0+/-0.4% mAP@0.5 at 2.14M parameters, 7.8 points below YOLOv10n (31.8%), a deficit that transfers to UAVDT (-10.0 points) and is confirmed by held-out and test-dev evaluation (23.5%, 22.5%). Background false positives, localization error, and duplicate detections move in the direction AG-FPN and Wise-IoU were designed to push. Ablation traces the deficit to a specific source: the P2/-P5 head swap costs 2.5 points independently plus a 2.5-point interaction penalty when layered onto a backbone weakened by PC-C2f, whose own 2.0-point loss is consistent with a partial pretrained-weight transplant (73/150 backbone tensors transfer). The failure is attributable to a specific interaction, not the four components individually. Composability must be verified directly, not assumed. Code/checkpoints: https://github.com/Mudassiruddin7/Small-Object-Detection-in-UAV-Imagery.

AI.tldr: 该论文直接检验"独立验证有效的方法组合后仍有效"这一假设，将四种技术整合为LAF-YOLOv10，发现组合后性能反而比原始YOLOv10n低7.8个百分点，证明可组合性不成立。
AI.motivation: 通用目标检测器在无人机（UAV）影像上精度下降，因为目标仅有几个像素且机载算力有限。已有工作假设：将各自独立验证有效的架构技术组合进一个检测器后，增益可以叠加。本文直接对这一假设进行压力测试（stress-test），检验组合效果是否等于各组件单独贡献之和。
AI.method: 将四种技术整合进YOLOv10n构成LAF-YOLOv10：部分卷积C2f骨干块（PC-C2f）、注意力引导特征金字塔网络（AG-FPN）、用P2检测头替换大目标P5头、Wise-IoU v3回归损失。在VisDrone-DET2019上以三个随机种子（42、123、256）训练三次，与未修改的YOLOv10n对比，并采用TIDE误差分解、逐类别分析、逐组件消融、注意力/损失对比、向UAVDT的零样本迁移，以及留出集/test-dev评估来定位组合成功或失败的具体来源。
AI.result: 可组合性在此不成立。LAF-YOLOv10仅达24.0±0.4% mAP@0.5，参数量2.14M，比YOLOv10n（31.8%）低7.8个百分点；这一劣势迁移到UAVDT后扩大为-10.0个百分点，并被留出集与test-dev评估确认（23.5%、22.5%）。背景误检、定位误差与重复检测的走向恰与AG-FPN和Wise-IoU的设计目标相反。消融实验将性能损失定位到具体来源：P2替换P5检测头独立造成2.5个百分点损失，叠加在被PC-C2f削弱的骨干上时又产生2.5个百分点的交互惩罚；而PC-C2f自身2.0个百分点损失与部分预训练权重移植（150个骨干张量仅转移73个）一致。
AI.conclusion: 性能下降应归因于组件间特定的交互作用，而非四个组件各自本身的问题。因此，方法可组合性必须被直接验证，而不能被假设。代码与检查点已开源。

title: TATK: Triple-Aware Top-K Learning with Knowledge-Grounded Verification for LLM-based Sequential Recommendation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 23 pages, including references and appendix
summary: LLM-based sequential recommenders usually cast next-item prediction as text generation, but this interface is poorly matched to full-catalog top-K ranking. We propose TATK, a Triple-Aware framework that couples Top-K Learning (TKL) with Knowledge-Grounded Verification (KGV) for LLM-based sequential recommendation. Top-K Learning combines context-aware metadata-KG prompt grounding with position-aware top-K rewards, aligning training with ranking utility; Knowledge-Grounded Verification then applies structure-aware reranking over the top-M candidates after a single LLM forward pass, using the same metadata-derived item graph. We evaluate TATK on Musical Instruments, CDs and Vinyl, and Video Games from Amazon Reviews 2023 under a matched R2ec-style full-catalog protocol. Experiments use Gemma-2-2B-It and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct backbones, compare against sequential, generative, KG-augmented, and reasoning-enhanced baselines, and include component, reward-shape, sequence-perturbation, reranking, relation-quality, and candidate-pool diagnostics. TATK improves over the matched R2ec reproduction on all 36 reported metrics. On NDCG@10, it improves Qwen by 8.05%, 4.26%, and 3.78% on the three datasets, and improves Gemma by 27.03%, 10.52%, and 10.23%, while keeping inference within 1.17x of Base RecPO latency. The diagnostics show that structural evidence is most useful for recoverable top-M candidates with reliable KG support, and should be gated when metadata relations are sparse or noisy.

AI.tldr: 提出TATK框架，将Top-K学习与知识图谱校验结合，用于LLM序列推荐，在三个Amazon数据集上36项指标全面超越R2ec复现基线。
AI.motivation: LLM序列推荐通常将下一物品预测建模为文本生成，该接口与全目录Top-K排序任务匹配度差，训练目标与排序效用不一致。
AI.method: TATK由两部分组成：Top-K学习（TKL）将上下文感知的metadata-KG提示接地与位置感知的Top-K奖励结合，使训练对齐排序效用；知识接地校验（KGV）在单次LLM前向传播后，基于同一metadata导出的物品图对Top-M候选进行结构感知重排序。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews 2023的Musical Instruments、CDs and Vinyl、Video Games上，采用匹配的R2ec式全目录协议，以Gemma-2-2B-It与Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct为骨干，对比序列、生成、KG增强与推理增强基线。在全部36项指标上超越匹配的R2ec复现；NDCG@10上Qwen分别提升8.05%、4.26%、3.78%，Gemma分别提升27.03%、10.52%、10.23%，推理延迟控制在Base RecPO的1.17倍以内。
AI.conclusion: 结构证据对具备可靠KG支持且可恢复的Top-M候选最有用，当metadata关系稀疏或含噪时应进行门控；TATK在保持推理效率的同时显著提升全目录Top-K排序效果。

title: Disentangling Topology and Diversity in Multi-Agent LLMs for Multilingual Low-Resource Emotion Detection
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 25 tables. Accepted at the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/eracoding/topologyxdiversity
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems combine multiple inference calls, but prior work often confounds how calls are connected with how they are diversified. We study these factors independently: inference topology and source of inter-agent diversity. In a controlled $2 \times 3$ matrix, we cross parallel aggregation and sequential refinement with stochastic sampling, role prompting, and learned QLoRA specialization, under a fixed three-call budget and output protocol within each backbone. Using Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we evaluate all six configurations on multilingual low-resource emotion detection across nine languages. Parallel learned specialization is strongest on Qwen at 52.83 Macro-F1 and reaches 52.94 on Llama. On Qwen it also exceeds same-backbone zero-shot, few-shot, CoT, and seven-call self-consistency baselines. The preferred topology depends on diversity source: sequential refinement helps stochastic and prompted settings, while the learned Width advantage shrinks from 2.83 points on Qwen to 0.17 on Llama. Depth-wise analysis suggests that later learned specialists can overwrite correct early predictions, although the aggregate effect is backbone-dependent. Overall, how agents are differentiated produces larger performance shifts than topology, which should be evaluated jointly with specialization.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控2×3实验矩阵，将多智能体LLM系统中的推理拓扑（并行聚合 vs 顺序精炼）与智能体多样性来源（随机采样、角色提示、QLoRA学习型专门化）解耦，在多语言低资源情感检测任务上系统评估二者影响。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM研究常将"调用如何连接"与"如何实现多样化"两个因素混淆，无法厘清各自贡献，因此需要在控制变量条件下独立考察推理拓扑与智能体间多样性来源的作用。
AI.method: 构建2×3受控矩阵，交叉并行聚合/顺序精炼两种拓扑与随机采样、角色提示、学习型QLoRA专门化三种多样性来源，在固定三次调用预算和统一输出协议下，使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct两个骨干，在九种语言的多语言低资源情感检测任务上评估全部六种配置。
AI.result: 并行学习型专门化在Qwen上表现最佳（52.83 Macro-F1），在Llama上达52.94。在Qwen上其还超过同骨干的零样本、少样本、CoT及七次调用自一致性基线。最优拓扑依赖多样性来源：顺序精炼有利于随机采样与提示设置，而学习型宽度优势从Qwen的2.83分缩小至Llama的0.17分。深度分析表明后期学习型专家可能覆盖早期正确预测，但总体效应依赖骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: 智能体差异化方式对性能的影响大于拓扑结构，且拓扑需与专门化方式联合评估。

title: Domain-specific Pretraining Profile and Transformer Performance: Evidence from Modeling Digital Pragmatics in Arabic-English Code-switching
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables
summary: This study highlights the role of domain-specific pretraining profile (DSPP) in Transformer performance for modeling digital pragmatics in Arabic-English code-switched discourse. It evaluates MARBERT and XLM-R(oBERTa), with BERT serving as a general-purpose baseline. The models were evaluated on their ability to classify context-sensitive pragmatic functions in code-switched social-media discourse. 11695 unique X posts were collected via Python and utilized for the study. The study employs a quantitative and qualitative NLP approach, following a supervised pipeline. Findings unveil that MARBERT consistently surpasses XLM-R with validation Macro F1 increasing from 0.39 to 0.84 and validation loss decreasing from 0.55 to 0.19. On an independent test set, it achieved 0.96 accuracy, 0.83 macro precision, 0.87 macro recall, and 0.85 Macro F1, while XLM-R achieved 0.92 test accuracy but a substantially lower Macro F1 of 0.52. This was also supported by class-level performance where MARBERT outperforms XLM-R considerably with F1 improvements ranging from +0.33 to +0.60, demonstrating a clear advantage in modeling Arabic digital pragmatics. The study concludes that Transformer performance depends more on DSPP than multilingual coverage alone, as the latter does not guarantee optimal performance on a highly specialized pragmatic classification task.

AI.tldr: 研究比较MARBERT与XLM-R(oBERTa)（BERT为通用基线）在阿拉伯语-英语语码转换社交媒体话语中建模语用功能的表现，发现领域特定预训练画像（DSPP）比多语言覆盖度更关键：MARBERT验证Macro F1由0.39升至0.84、验证损失由0.55降至0.19，独立测试集准确率0.96、Macro F1 0.85，显著优于XLM-R（准确率0.92但Macro F1仅0.52）。
AI.motivation: 探究Transformer模型在高度专业化的阿拉伯语数字语用分类任务中，其性能究竟取决于领域特定的预训练画像（DSPP），还是仅靠多语言覆盖度。研究针对语码转换社交媒体话语中语境敏感的语用功能建模这一难点，检验多语言模型是否必然带来最优表现。
AI.method: 采用定量与定性结合的NLP方法，构建有监督流水线。通过Python采集11695条唯一的X平台帖子作为数据。模型方面评估MARBERT与XLM-R(oBERTa)，并以BERT作为通用基线，任务为对语码转换社交媒体话语中语境敏感的语用功能进行分类。评估指标包括验证集Macro F1、验证损失，以及独立测试集上的准确率、宏精确率、宏召回率和Macro F1，并辅以类别层面（class-level）的性能分析。
AI.result: MARBERT持续优于XLM-R：验证Macro F1从0.39提升至0.84，验证损失从0.55下降至0.19。在独立测试集上，MARBERT达到0.96准确率、0.83宏精确率、0.87宏召回率和0.85 Macro F1；而XLM-R虽取得0.92的测试准确率，但Macro F1仅0.52，明显偏低。类别层面结果同样支持该结论，MARBERT相较XLM-R的F1提升范围为+0.33至+0.60，在阿拉伯语数字语用建模上优势显著。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型的性能更多取决于领域特定预训练画像（DSPP），而非单纯的多语言覆盖度；多语言覆盖并不能保证在高度专业化的语用分类任务上取得最优表现。研究凸显了领域适配预训练对阿拉伯语数字语用建模的关键作用。

title: A Building as a Repository: KIR, a Typed Intermediate Representation for Agent-Authored Building Information Models
comment: 13-page paper and 10-page supplement; 8 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/5vbkgsghhh-hash/kir
summary: Autonomous agents that author building information models need more than access to a host API. They need a representation of what they intended, what a compiler decided on their behalf, what was refused, what was observed after execution and what remains unknown. We present KIR, a typed intermediate representation in which a building is authored as a program held in a versioned repository and lowered to host applications as build targets. KIR is organised around seven ways in which a generator writing into a stateful, partially observable host goes silently wrong, and gives each a representation in data: ambiguous selectors become typed refusals with candidates; defaults keep their provenance; obligations that will not be checked are named before execution; vacuous witnesses are rejected statically; a lost transaction response becomes the state UNCONFIRMED with a verify-before-retry rule; the reverse path obeys a census invariant; and decisions are bound by digest to the state they were made against. On a pinned snapshot with 83 operation contracts and Revit as the only backend, offline experiments refuse 29 of 42 stress-test programs with diagnostic codes and no uncaught exception, name 38 of 377 witness obligations as unwitnessable, admit 31 of 100 combinations of execution, witness and acceptance states under seven stated invariants, and find no vacuous witness in 219 certificate runs; a 60-storey tower is 11,263 characters as KIR against 3,709,235 characters of emitted C#. Native Revit runs are reported from project records and kept separate from reproduced results. A controlled comparison with agents that write host code directly is specified but not yet executed; it is the principal open question.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KIR——一种类型化中间表示，将建筑建模视为以版本化仓库保存的程序，并编译为宿主应用（Revit）构建目标；其核心是围绕生成式代理在状态化、部分可观测宿主中悄然出错的七种方式，为每一种提供数据层面的表示。
AI.motivation: 自主代理编写建筑信息模型时，仅访问宿主API是不够的：它们需要表示自身意图、编译器代为决定的决策、被拒绝的操作、执行后的观测结果以及未知状态。现有方式缺乏对这种"意图—决策—拒绝—观测—未知"全链路的显式表示。
AI.method: KIR围绕七类静默失效模式设计表示：(1)歧义选择器转为带候选的类型化拒绝；(2)默认值保留其来源（provenance）；(3)不会被检查的义务在执行前被命名；(4)空洞见证（vacuous witness）被静态拒绝；(5)丢失的事务响应变为UNCONFIRMED状态并配以重试前验证规则；(6)反向路径遵循普查不变量（census invariant）；(7)决策通过摘要（digest）绑定到其作出时所依据的状态。实验在固定快照上进行，含83个操作契约，Revit为唯一后端。
AI.result: 离线实验中：42个压力测试程序中拒绝29个并给出诊断码且无未捕获异常；377个见证义务中命名38个为不可见证；在七项声明不变量下，100种执行/见证/接受状态组合中接纳31种；219次证书运行中未发现空洞见证。一栋60层塔楼以KIR表示为11,263字符，而生成的C#代码为3,709,235字符。Native Revit运行结果来自项目记录，与可复现结果分开报告。
AI.conclusion: KIR为生成式代理在状态化、部分可观测宿主中的建筑建模提供了显式的失败表示与不变量约束，在离线实验中展现出高拒绝率与诊断能力，并显著压缩了表示体积；与直接编写宿主代码的代理的受控对比已设计但尚未执行，是主要待解问题。

title: Efficient Multimodal Generative Recommendation with Latent Narrative Reasoning
summary: Generative recommendation reformulates item prediction as semantic identifier generation, yet episodic content introduces a fundamentally different setting where the target is determined by narrative evolution rather than user preference. This task requires models to understand multimodal storyline progression while addressing the efficiency challenges caused by redundant visual contexts and costly explicit reasoning generation. We propose \textbf{NarraLite}, an efficient multimodal generative recommendation framework that jointly compresses perception and reasoning. Specifically, Progressive Spectral Compression selectively distills long visual contexts into compact narrative-relevant evidence, preserving transition-critical information while reducing redundant visual computation. Latent Narrative Reasoning introduces context-routed latent reasoning tokens and aligns their contextualized representations with future continuation semantics, enabling implicit narrative inference without autoregressively decoding textual rationales. We further establish a user-agnostic multimodal benchmark for short-form drama continuation across UGC, PGC, and OOD settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NarraLite consistently improves continuation accuracy, narrative coherence, and robustness over existing approaches, while achieving a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: NarraLite：面向情节式内容的高效多模态生成式推荐框架，通过渐进谱压缩与隐式叙事推理，联合压缩感知与推理，显著提升短剧续接任务的准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐将物品预测重构为语义标识符生成，但情节式内容场景中目标由叙事演进决定而非用户偏好，现有方法难以理解多模态故事线推进，同时受冗余视觉上下文与高昂显式推理生成成本制约。
AI.method: 提出NarraLite框架：1）渐进谱压缩（Progressive Spectral Compression），选择性将长视觉上下文蒸馏为紧凑的叙事相关证据，保留转场关键信息并减少冗余视觉计算；2）隐式叙事推理（Latent Narrative Reasoning），引入上下文路由的隐式推理token，并将其上下文化表示与未来续接语义对齐，实现无需自回归解码文本理由的隐式叙事推断。
AI.result: 构建了用户无关的多模态短剧续接基准，覆盖UGC、PGC与OOD场景。实验表明NarraLite在续接准确率、叙事连贯性与鲁棒性上持续优于现有方法，并实现良好的精度—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: NarraLite通过联合压缩感知与推理，为情节式多模态生成式推荐提供了高效且有效的解决方案，并建立了相应的评测基准。

title: Reverse Spatio-Temporal Disease Progression Modelling
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at SASHIMI 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: Deep learning-based spatio-temporal disease progression models commonly overlook the incubation period of progressive diseases, limiting the use of those models in early interventions, which are vital for not easily reversible diseases such as Alzheimer's. This is because, the existing deep learning based longitudinal disease-progression models are almost always run forward: from an observed baseline they predict future decline. In many clinical settings, however, imaging begins only after pathology is suspected or already visible, the earlier, healthier patient-specific reference was never acquired. To address this, we propose to study reverse disease progression prediction: given later diseased anatomy, reconstruct the unobserved healthier anatomy that preceded it. We use a two-stage model in which a frozen 3D vector-quantised autoencoder defines a compact discrete latent space, while a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) learns continuous-time dynamics in that space. A recurrent encoder reads late observations in reverse temporal order, initialises the latent state, and the ODE is integrated backwards across the trajectory. On a controlled Morpho-MNIST benchmark with a sinusoidal perturbation, our model successfully recovered the unseen previous states from later observations of the non-monotonic trajectory. On longitudinal brain MRIs from Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, at the task to recover the previous unseen trajectory towards healthy states of the patients from observed later diseased states, our model outperforms the baselines that uses copy-nearest and mean-observed, with positive disease-reversal scores in every diagnostic stratum. We hope that our work can provide insights and tools towards discovering the incubation periods from single-shot scans, and developing early interventions of diseases based on imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出反向疾病进展预测：由后期病灶解剖重建其之前未观测到的更健康状态，用冻结3D VQ-AE定义离散隐空间，Neural ODE学习连续时间动力学，递归编码器逆序读取晚期观测以初始化并反向积分；在Morpho-MNIST与ADNI上验证可恢复未见过的早期状态。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习时空疾病进展模型多为"前向"预测，即从观测基线推未来衰退，普遍忽略疾病潜伏期，难以支撑早期干预；而临床中影像常在病理已疑似或可见后才采集，患者更健康的个体化参考影像从未获得，因此需要从后期病灶反推更早健康状态。
AI.method: 两阶段模型：第一阶段用冻结的3D矢量量化自编码器（VQ-AE）构建紧凑离散隐空间；第二阶段在该隐空间上用神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）学习连续时间动力学。递归编码器按逆时间顺序读取晚期观测，初始化隐状态，再将ODE沿轨迹反向积分，从而重建更早的、未观测到的更健康解剖状态。
AI.result: 在带正弦扰动的受控Morpho-MNIST基准上，模型成功从非单调轨迹的后期观测中恢复出未见过的先前状态；在ADNI纵向脑MRI上，以从已观测后期病灶状态恢复患者朝向健康状态的先前未观测轨迹为任务，模型优于copy-nearest与mean-observed基线，在所有诊断分层中均取得正的疾病逆转评分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为从单次扫描中发现疾病潜伏期、并基于影像开展疾病早期干预提供了思路与工具。

title: Direct Conditional Transition Sampling for Diffusion Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion inverse solvers typically choose between local measurement guidance and costly clean-space posterior updates. Independent posterior refresh can improve global correction by sampling a clean conditional and re-noising it, but its practical realization requires probability-flow ODE integration and clean-space Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). We propose Direct Conditional Transition Sampling (DCTS), a direct stochastic-flow approximation to the same ideal refresh target. Rather than explicitly drawing a clean sample, DCTS estimates the measurement-conditioned clean mean along a short inner path and transports Gaussian source noise directly to the next noisy state. A denoiser-compatible sufficient statistic and a covariance-scaled operator update enable this conditional-mean estimation. Experiments on four inverse problems demonstrate that DCTS achieves competitive reconstruction quality with up to $16.8\times$ speedups over competing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练扩散逆问题求解器DCTS，通过直接随机流近似实现条件后验刷新，避免显式干净样本采样，在四个逆问题上取得竞争性重建质量并最高加速16.8倍。
AI.motivation: 免训练扩散逆求解器存在两难：局部测量引导全局校正能力弱，而干净空间后验更新（采样干净条件样本并重新加噪）虽能改善全局校正，但需概率流ODE积分与干净空间MCMC，计算代价高昂。因此需要一种更高效地逼近理想后验刷新目标的方法。
AI.method: 提出直接条件转移采样（DCTS），对理想刷新目标做直接随机流近似。不显式抽取干净样本，而是在短内路径上估计测量条件下的干净均值，并将高斯源噪声直接传输到下一噪声状态。借助去噪器兼容的充分统计量与协方差缩放的算子更新实现该条件均值估计。
AI.result: 在四个逆问题上的实验表明，DCTS达到竞争性的重建质量，相较对比方法最高实现16.8倍加速。
AI.conclusion: DCTS以直接随机流近似替代代价高昂的ODE积分与干净空间MCMC，在保持重建质量的同时显著提升效率，为免训练扩散逆求解提供了一种高效的后验刷新方案。

title: The Immutable Past: Formalizing State Mutability and Conflict Resolution in Mutable RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) serves as the primary memory architecture for long-horizon autonomous agents. However, treating shared memory as an append-only stream introduces \textit{Semantic Shadowing}, a critical failure mode where conflicting historical observations accumulate and statistically dominate valid recent updates. In dynamic environments, this results in severe state divergence as agents retrieve and act upon obsolete facts. This paper formalizes the mechanics of State Mutability to prove that standard dense retrieval suffers from Asymptotic Recall Decay. Furthermore, we formally demonstrate a Majority Vote Trap, revealing that increasing the retrieval context window paradoxically degrades generation accuracy by diluting the attention mechanism under conditions of semantic equivalence. To resolve this, we introduce GC-Mem (Garbage Collection for Memory), a strict inference-time consistency protocol. Unlike heuristic time-decay mechanisms---which indiscriminately destroy valid long-term memory---GC-Mem relies purely on a temporal dominance operator ($Φ_{\mathcal{T}}$) paired with contradiction detection to surgically excise shadowed context. Evaluated across a rigorous, behaviorally inferred benchmark of 137,760 memory chunks and continuous accumulation sweeps, standard RAG and timestamp re-ranking baselines experience severe degradation. In contrast, GC-Mem empirically recovers $>90\%$ conflict resolution accuracy. We establish strict precision and recall deployment thresholds, ensuring state convergence where standard mutable RAG fundamentally fails.

AI.tldr: 本文指出RAG作为长期自主智能体记忆架构时存在"语义遮蔽"失效模式，会导致检索到过时事实并产生状态分歧。作者形式化了状态可变性机制，证明标准密集检索存在渐进召回衰减和"多数投票陷阱"，并提出GC-Mem推理时一致性协议，通过时序支配算子Φ_T与矛盾检测剔除此类遮蔽上下文，在137,760个记忆块的基准上实现>90%冲突解决准确率。
AI.motivation: RAG被广泛用作长期自主智能体的主要记忆架构，但将共享记忆视为只追加的流会引入语义遮蔽：冲突的历史观测不断累积并在统计上压过有效的近期更新，导致智能体在动态环境中检索并依据过时事实行动，产生严重状态分歧。现有启发式时间衰减机制又会不加区分地破坏有效的长期记忆，因此需要一种既能剔除过时冲突信息、又能保留有效长期记忆的机制。
AI.method: 作者首先形式化状态可变性机制，证明标准密集检索存在渐进召回衰减，并形式化论证"多数投票陷阱"，即在语义等价条件下扩大检索上下文窗口反而稀释注意力、降低生成准确率。随后提出GC-Mem（记忆垃圾回收），一种严格的推理时一致性协议：不采用启发式时间衰减，而是仅依赖时序支配算子Φ_T结合矛盾检测，外科手术式地剔除被遮蔽的上下文。评估采用行为推断构建的基准，包含137,760个记忆块，并进行了持续累积扫描实验，与标准RAG及时间戳重排序基线对比。
AI.result: 在包含137,760个记忆块的严格行为推断基准及持续累积扫描中，标准RAG与时间戳重排序基线出现严重性能退化；而GC-Mem在实证上恢复了>90%的冲突解决准确率。作者还建立了严格的精度与召回部署阈值，确保状态收敛，而标准可变RAG在此条件下从根本上失败。
AI.conclusion: 将共享记忆视为只追加流会导致语义遮蔽，使标准密集检索出现渐进召回衰减，且扩大上下文窗口会因多数投票陷阱而适得其反。GC-Mem通过时序支配算子与矛盾检测进行精准剔除，在不破坏有效长期记忆的前提下显著提升冲突解决能力，并给出可部署的精度/召回阈值，保障状态收敛。

title: Open-UniMo: Towards Unified Motion-Language Understanding and Generation in the Open World
summary: Unified motion generation and understanding is crucial for embodied AI systems that can both synthesize and interpret human actions in open-world environments. Existing motion-language models often treat motion as an auxiliary modality of a language model, leading to text-dominated representations and limited cross-modal interaction. Moreover, the next-token prediction paradigm is not naturally suited to long motion sequences, where autoregressive generation may accumulate prediction errors. To address these challenges, we propose Open-UniMo, a unified Large Motion-Language Model (LMLM) trained on million-scale open-world motion-language data. Open-UniMo promotes modality parity by extending Qwen's vocabulary of about 150K text tokens with 64K motion tokens, enabling motion and language to share a unified token space. We further introduce motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought reasoning as an intermediate representation to bridge language semantics and motion dynamics. Open-UniMo is trained with a two-stage pipeline, where supervised fine-tuning establishes CoT-guided bidirectional motion-language mapping and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves semantic alignment while mitigating cumulative errors in autoregressive motion-token generation. To support comprehensive evaluation, we propose Open-MoBench, a VLM-guided benchmark for assessing text-to-motion (T2M) generation, motion-to-text (M2T) understanding, and bidirectional consistency. Extensive experiments show that Open-UniMo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both conventional metrics and Open-MoBench. Furthermore, ablation studies reveal that M2T understanding is not primarily limited by motion-token vocabulary size; instead, coupling M2T with the learnable T2M generation path yields stronger cross-modal representations, demonstrating that generation can facilitate understanding in AR-based motion-language modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Open-UniMo，一个统一的大规模运动-语言模型（LMLM），通过扩展Qwen词表、引入运动一致性CoT推理与两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO），实现运动生成与理解的双向统一，并构建Open-MoBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有运动-语言模型将运动视为语言模型的辅助模态，导致表征受文本主导、跨模态交互不足；同时next-token预测范式难以适配长运动序列，自回归生成易累积预测误差。因此需要一种模态对等、能兼顾生成与理解的统一框架。
AI.method: 在百万级开放世界运动-语言数据上训练Open-UniMo：1）将Qwen约150K文本词表扩展64K运动token，使运动与语言共享统一token空间以实现模态对等；2）引入运动一致性Chain-of-Thought作为连接语言语义与运动动态的中间表征；3）两阶段训练——SFT建立CoT引导的双向运动-语言映射，GRPO优化语义对齐并缓解自回归运动token生成的累积误差；4）提出VLM引导的Open-MoBench基准，评估T2M生成、M2T理解及双向一致性。
AI.result: Open-UniMo在传统指标与Open-MoBench上均达到state-of-the-art。消融实验表明：M2T理解能力并非主要受运动token词表规模限制；将M2T与可学习的T2M生成路径耦合可获得更强的跨模态表征。
AI.conclusion: 在基于自回归的运动-语言建模中，生成可以促进理解（generation facilitates understanding），统一token空间与CoT推理是提升跨模态运动-语言能力的关键设计。

title: ESAFusion: LiDAR--4-D Radar Fusion via Local Geometric Complementation and Multiscale Adaptive Interaction for 3-D Object Detection
summary: LiDAR--4-D radar fusion combines accurate spatial geometry with motion and reflectivity cues from radar, offering a promising solution for 3-D object detection in complex driving environments. However, sparse radar observations and differences in spatial sampling between the two modalities complicate reliable cross-modal complementation. Moreover, the relative importance of modalities and feature scales varies across spatial regions, making adaptive fusion challenging. To address these challenges, we propose ESAFusion, an evidence-aware and scale-adaptive framework that combines local geometric complementation with multiscale adaptive interaction. Specifically, we introduce an Evidence-Aware Radar Selection (ERS) module to suppress radar clutter using motion and observation-quality evidence while retaining foreground confidence for subsequent fusion. Then, the Pillar-Level Complementary Encoder (PCE) improves cross-modal complementation under mismatched spatial sampling using local geometric support from neighboring LiDAR pillars. We further design an Intra- and Inter-Scale Adaptive Fusion (ISAF) module to adaptively adjust the contributions of different modalities and feature scales in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space. Extensive experiments on the View-of-Delft (VoD) dataset show that ESAFusion achieves the highest mean average precision (mAP) among the compared methods, reaching 74.60% in the Entire Annotated Area and 88.89% in the Driving Corridor. It also attains the highest average precision (AP) for Cyclist among these methods in both regions while running at 19.23 FPS. Evaluations on VoD-Fog further demonstrate robustness under progressively degraded LiDAR observations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/SenJieHu549/ESAFusion.

AI.tldr: 提出ESAFusion框架，通过证据感知雷达选择、柱级互补编码器和尺度内/间自适应融合，实现LiDAR-4D雷达3D目标检测的鲁棒跨模态融合。
AI.motivation: LiDAR与4D雷达融合可结合精确空间几何与运动/反射率线索，但雷达观测稀疏、两模态空间采样不一致，且模态与特征尺度的相对重要性随空间区域变化，导致可靠互补与自适应融合困难。
AI.method: ESAFusion包含三个模块：Evidence-Aware Radar Selection (ERS) 利用运动与观测质量证据抑制雷达杂波并保留前景置信度；Pillar-Level Complementary Encoder (PCE) 借助邻近LiDAR柱的局部几何支撑改善采样不匹配下的跨模态互补；Intra- and Inter-Scale Adaptive Fusion (ISAF) 在BEV空间自适应调整不同模态与特征尺度的贡献。
AI.result: 在VoD数据集上取得对比方法中最高的mAP：Entire Annotated Area 74.60%，Driving Corridor 88.89%；两区域Cyclist类别AP最高；运行速度19.23 FPS。VoD-Fog上验证了LiDAR观测逐步退化时的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ESAFusion通过证据感知与尺度自适应策略有效解决了LiDAR-4D雷达融合中的稀疏性与采样不匹配问题，在精度、特定类别性能与鲁棒性上均具优势，代码将开源。

title: TTDF: A Two-Stage Framework for Reliable Surgical Phase Transition Detection
comment: Accepted at the COLAS Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable workflow transition detection is important for context-aware surgical assistance and downstream decision support. However, online surgical phase recognizers primarily focus on frame-wise accuracy and temporal consistency, rather than the reliability of workflow transition events. Directly converting phase changes into events is unreliable: temporal jitter and workflow-illegal switches produce false or duplicate events, while persistent, workflow-consistent candidates may remain incorrect. To address this limitation, we formulate reliable workflow transition detection as a distinct event-level task operating on outputs of a frozen online phase recognizer. We propose the Two-Stage Transition Detection Framework (TTDF), a causal framework that progressively filters transition candidates. Transition Candidate Extraction (TCE) first applies a minimum-duration requirement and a workflow-graph constraint to remove false candidates caused by temporal jitter and phase transitions not allowed by the workflow graph. Specifically, a candidate is retained only if the predicted target phase persists for a minimum duration and the ordered phase pair belongs to the workflow graph's allowed transition set. TCE thereby produces a high-recall candidate set without additional training. Transition Candidate Verification (TCV) suppresses remaining false candidates using phase-posterior shifts and visual-change cues from frozen DINOv2 features. Events are assessed using a phase-pair-aware one-to-one matching protocol. Experiments on Cholec80 show that TTDF reduces false transition emissions while preserving recall and controlling decision delay.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段过渡检测框架TTDF，将可靠的工作流过渡检测建模为独立的事件级任务，在冻结的在线阶段识别器输出上进行因果式候选过滤与验证。
AI.motivation: 在线手术阶段识别器主要关注逐帧准确率和时间一致性，而非工作流过渡事件本身的可靠性；直接将阶段变化转换为事件会因时间抖动和工作流非法切换产生虚假或重复事件，而持久且符合工作流的候选也可能是错误的。
AI.method: TTDF包含两个因果阶段：过渡候选提取（TCE）先施加最小持续时间要求与工作流图约束（候选需目标阶段持续达到最小时长，且有序阶段对属于工作流图允许的过渡集合），无需额外训练即可生成高召回候选集；过渡候选验证（TCV）利用阶段后验偏移与来自冻结DINOv2特征的视觉变化线索抑制剩余虚假候选；采用阶段对感知的一对一匹配协议评估事件。
AI.result: 在Cholec80上，TTDF减少了虚假过渡发射，同时保持召回率并控制了决策延迟。
AI.conclusion: TTDF将工作流过渡检测与逐帧识别解耦，作为事件级任务在冻结识别器输出上进行因果候选过滤与验证，可在不牺牲召回的前提下提升过渡事件的可靠性，适用于情景感知手术辅助与下游决策支持。

title: SCOUT-SLAM: Structurally-Coupled Dual Uncertainty-Aware 3DGS SLAM in the Wild
summary: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM (3DGS-SLAM) has gained significant momentum in simultaneous localization and 3DGS scene reconstruction. In real-world scenarios with rapid camera motion and cluttered dynamic environments, existing methods rely on the stability of the underlying scene reconstruction to model uncertainty. This leads to a circular dependency between camera tracking accuracy and reconstruction quality: reconstruction instabilities degrade uncertainty modeling, which affects accurate camera tracking and static scene reconstruction. To address this, the paper proposes SCOUT-SLAM, a structurally-coupled dual-uncertainty framework in which both uncertainties are estimated from a shared base network. A low-rank adaptation of this network, trained on multi-view feature consistency, estimates a tracking uncertainty that does not depend solely on the reconstruction quality. A spatially-adaptive prior modulates the network's training objective so that reconstruction instability does not inflate uncertainty on static regions, keeping the shared representation intact for both branches. Evaluations on dynamic benchmarks (TUM RGB-D, Bonn Dynamic, Wild-SLAM MoCap) demonstrate that SCOUT-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art camera tracking accuracy and artifact-free static scene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出SCOUT-SLAM，一种结构耦合的双不确定性框架，通过共享基础网络估计跟踪不确定性与重建不确定性，解决3DGS-SLAM中相机跟踪精度与重建质量之间的循环依赖问题。
AI.motivation: 在快速相机运动与杂乱动态环境的真实场景中，现有3DGS-SLAM方法依赖底层场景重建的稳定性来建模不确定性，导致跟踪精度与重建质量之间形成循环依赖：重建不稳定会降低不确定性建模质量，进而影响相机跟踪与静态场景重建。
AI.method: 提出结构耦合的双不确定性框架，两种不确定性均由共享基础网络估计。利用基于多视图特征一致性训练的低秩适配（LoRA）模块估计跟踪不确定性，使其不完全依赖重建质量；同时用空间自适应先验调制网络训练目标，避免重建不稳定在静态区域上放大不确定性，从而保持共享表征对两个分支的有效性。
AI.result: 在动态基准（TUM RGB-D、Bonn Dynamic、Wild-SLAM MoCap）上的评估表明，SCOUT-SLAM 在相机跟踪精度上达到当前最优水平，并实现无伪影的静态场景重建。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦跟踪与重建的不确定性建模，SCOUT-SLAM 打破了跟踪精度与重建质量之间的循环依赖，在动态环境下同时提升了跟踪精度与静态重建质量。

title: Know When to Stop, Where to Restart: Accelerating Multi-Turn Agentic On-Policy Distillation
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has become a standard approach for transferring capabilities from large teachers to compact students. Its cost, however, is dominated by autoregressive student rollouts and scales poorly in multi-turn agentic settings. Existing acceleration methods truncate or relocate the supervision signal according to fixed, offline budgets, despite substantial variation in teacher-signal reliability both within and across trajectories. Our empirical analysis on $τ^2$-bench reveals a clear structure in this variation: informative supervision is concentrated in the prefix of each turn, and, most importantly for multi-turn agentic training, the cross-turn loss of teacher endorsement is temporally locked to the student's first erroneous action rather than accumulating gradually over turns.
