Building on these findings, we propose STRIDE (Stop-and-Restart on-policy Distillation acceleration), which combines two complementary techniques: adaptive early stopping, which terminates a rollout once the cumulative teacher log-probability falls below an out-of-distribution threshold, and a prefix buffer, which caches high-quality prefixes and restarts generation at the weakest correct turn. Together, these mechanisms induce a data-driven curriculum that progressively extends coverage to later turns. On $τ^2$-bench retail, our method matches full-trajectory OPD and exceeds the 30B teacher at a $3.73\times$ speedup, surpasses the baseline itself at $2.34\times$, and retains a $4.51\times$ speedup under cross-domain multi-teacher training. As a supplementary generalization test beyond the agentic setting, STRIDE outperforms full OPD on AIME 2025 at a $5.10\times$ speedup and on AIME 2024 at a $3.08\times$ speedup; averaged across the two evaluations, both fixed-budget truncation baselines remain below full OPD.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE方法，通过自适应早停与前缀缓存加速多轮智能体场景下的on-policy蒸馏，在保持甚至超过全轨迹基线性能的同时实现约3.7倍以上加速。
AI.motivation: on-policy distillation（OPD）成本主要由学生自回归rollout主导，在多轮智能体场景中扩展性差；现有加速方法依据固定离线预算截断或迁移监督信号，忽视了教师信号可靠性在轨迹内与轨迹间的显著变化。
AI.method: 基于τ²-bench的实证分析发现：监督信息集中在每轮前缀，跨轮的教师认可损失时间锁定于学生首个错误动作而非逐轮累积。据此提出STRIDE，包含两项技术：自适应早停（当累积教师对数概率低于分布外阈值时终止rollout）与前缀缓存（缓存高质量前缀并从最弱的正确轮次重启生成），二者共同构成数据驱动课程以逐步扩展后期轮次覆盖。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench retail上匹配全轨迹OPD并以3.73×加速超越30B教师，以2.34×加速超越基线本身；跨域多教师训练下保持4.51×加速。泛化测试中，AIME 2025上以5.10×加速、AIME 2024上以3.08×加速优于全OPD，两项评估平均后固定预算截断基线均低于全OPD。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE利用教师信号可靠性的结构化变化，实现数据驱动的自适应监督分配，在多轮智能体与推理任务上兼具效率与性能优势，优于固定预算截断方法。

title: CompCQR: Compositional Query Generation for Training-Free Conversational Search
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Multi-turn interactions with LLMs are becoming increasingly common in information-seeking scenarios. However, user queries are often ambiguous and context-dependent, making them ill-suited for direct use as retriever queries. Conversational query reformulation (CQR) addresses this issue by rewriting the current utterance into a stand-alone query grounded in the dialogue history. Recent LLM-based CQR approaches achieve strong performance; however, their repeated LLM invocations and misalignment with downstream retrievers remain challenges. In this work, we begin from the observation that retrievers are highly sensitive to content ordering: simply reordering the same content can lead to changes in retrieval coverage and performance. Based on this, we propose a novel training-free method that generates a very large number of queries with minimal LLM usage by compositionally combining a small set of atomic components. We further apply LLM reasoning to construct a high-quality document set that balances precision and recall while capturing the user's core intent. Our framework generalizes across both open- and closed-source LLMs as well as dense and sparse retrievers. It achieves strong performance on four widely used conversational benchmarks, with up to 22.5% relative MRR improvement over the previous state-of-the-art baseline with far fewer LLM calls.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的多轮对话查询改写框架，利用检索器对内容顺序敏感的观察，通过组合少量"原子组件"生成大量候选查询，并用LLM推理构建兼顾精准与召回的高质量文档集，在四个基准上显著超越SOTA且大幅减少LLM调用。
AI.motivation: 多轮交互中用户查询常存在歧义且依赖上下文，无法直接作为检索器查询，因此需要会话查询改写（CQR）。现有基于LLM的CQR方法虽性能强，但存在两大问题：重复调用LLM带来高昂开销，且改写结果与下游检索器不匹配（misalignment）。
AI.method: 基于"检索器对内容顺序高度敏感——同一内容仅重排即可改变检索覆盖与性能"这一观察，提出一种免训练方法：通过组合式拼接少量原子组件，以极少的LLM调用生成数量庞大的候选查询；再借助LLM推理构建兼顾精准率与召回率、并捕捉用户核心意图的高质量文档集。该框架对开源与闭源LLM、稠密与稀疏检索器均具泛化性。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的会话检索基准上取得强劲表现，相较此前SOTA基线在MRR上最高取得22.5%的相对提升，同时LLM调用次数远少于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，利用检索器对内容顺序的敏感性、通过原子组件组合生成大规模候选查询并结合LLM推理筛选文档，可在免训练条件下有效解决CQR中的LLM开销与检索器错配问题，实现高效且泛化的会话检索增强。

title: Optimizing Sparse Outcomes Through Dense Behavioral Signals via Value-Guided Preference Distillation
summary: Aligning multi-turn dialogue agents is usually framed as matching turn-level human preferences, yet direct optimization of long-term outcomes is often ineffective and prone to reward hacking. We formulate long-horizon dialogue optimization as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and train a multi-head value model that predicts a vector of observed user behaviors across multiple look-ahead horizons. Our findings demonstrate that a scalarized composite of dense auxiliary behavioral signals enables effective credit assignment and optimization of sparse outcomes. However, optimizing unconstrained single-objective proxies might induce policy degradations that are harmful when the agent is exposed to real users. To identify these failure modes prior to deployment, we establish a safety framework combining counterfactual user simulation with a validated dialogue-level outcome model to evaluate preference weightings and policy optimization methods. Finally, we demonstrate that distilling multi-objective value preferences into the policy via reference-anchored preference optimization matches on-policy online RL at a small fraction of its compute budget. Live A/B testing confirms that our distilled policy significantly improves long-term user retention, while simultaneously enhancing the positive behaviors and therapeutic-process markers.

AI.tldr: 将长时程多轮对话优化建模为多目标强化学习问题，通过多头部价值模型预测多维度、多视野的用户行为信号，利用稠密辅助信号的标量化组合进行信用分配，并以参考锚定偏好优化将多目标价值蒸馏进策略，实现低算力下媲美在线RL的效果，A/B测试验证长期留存与治疗过程指标双提升。
AI.motivation: 现有多轮对话对齐通常被框定为匹配单轮人类偏好，但直接优化长期结果往往效果不佳且易出现奖励攻击（reward hacking）。需要一种能有效进行长时程信用分配、并能提前识别部署前失败模式的优化与安全评估方案。
AI.method: 1) 将长时程对话优化形式化为多目标强化学习问题；2) 训练多头部价值模型，预测多维度观测用户行为在多个前瞻视野上的向量；3) 使用稠密辅助行为信号的标量化组合作为代理进行信用分配；4) 建立安全框架，结合反事实用户模拟与经验证的对话级结果模型，评估偏好权重与策略优化方法以识别失败模式；5) 通过参考锚定偏好优化（reference-anchored preference optimization）将多目标价值偏好蒸馏进策略。
AI.result: 标量化的稠密辅助行为信号组合能够有效进行信用分配并优化稀疏结果；蒸馏方法以在线RL的很小算力预算达到与其相当的性能；线上A/B测试表明蒸馏策略显著提升长期用户留存，同时增强正向行为与治疗过程标记。
AI.conclusion: 以多目标RL结合多视野价值预测与安全评估框架，可在部署前识别无约束单目标代理带来的策略退化风险；将多目标价值偏好蒸馏进策略，是实现高效、安全且长期有效的对话对齐的可行路径。

title: World-Action Models for Robot Learning and Control: A Survey
comment: 19 pages
summary: Robots operating in open environments act under partial observability, physical constraints, and dynamic task contexts. Beyond mapping observations and language instructions to actions, they must anticipate how candidate actions may affect future states and task-relevant outcomes. Recent advances in world models, video generation, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have motivated the development of World-Action Models (WAMs), which couple future world prediction with executable action generation. This survey provides a robotics-oriented review of WAMs. We clarify their scope relative to conventional world models, model-based reinforcement learning, action-conditioned video generation, and reactive VLA policies, and organize existing methods through a unified taxonomy covering representations, transition modeling, action interfaces, architectures, training pipelines, data modalities, and scaling strategies. We further review applications of WAMs in manipulation, navigation, and autonomous driving, and we summarize the datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and protocols used to evaluate WAM systems. Finally, we discuss key challenges in action alignment, world-action factorization, spatial and multi-view consistency, long-horizon memory, neural simulation for closed-loop policy learning, and efficient inference. Taken together, this survey aims to provide a concise technical foundation for integrating predictive world modeling with action generation, toward more reliable embodied robot intelligence. Project page: https://rcl-robotics.github.io/Awesome-World-Action-Models.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向机器人领域的World-Action Models（WAMs）综述，系统梳理了将未来世界预测与可执行动作生成相耦合的方法体系，涵盖统一分类法、应用、评测与挑战。
AI.motivation: 机器人在开放环境中面临部分可观测、物理约束和动态任务上下文，仅将观测与语言指令映射为动作是不够的，还需预测候选动作对未来状态及任务结果的影响。世界模型、视频生成与VLA策略的进展催生了WAMs，但该方向缺乏面向机器人学的系统性梳理。
AI.method: 综述性研究。明确WAMs相对于传统世界模型、基于模型的强化学习、动作条件视频生成与反应式VLA策略的边界；建立统一分类法，覆盖表征、转移建模、动作接口、架构、训练流程、数据模态与扩展策略；并整理数据集、基准、指标与评测协议。
AI.result: 系统综述了WAMs在操作、导航与自动驾驶中的应用，汇总了用于评估WAM系统的数据集、基准、指标和协议，并归纳出该领域的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 关键挑战包括动作对齐、世界-动作解耦、空间与多视角一致性、长时记忆、用于闭环策略学习的神经仿真以及高效推理。本综述旨在为将预测性世界建模与动作生成相结合提供简明技术基础，推动更可靠的具身机器人智能。

title: Evaluating Contextual Bias in CNN Image Classification: Evidence from Agricultural Benchmark Datasets
summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are typically evaluated using held-out classification accuracy, an approach that presupposes predictions are based primarily on the intended object of interest rather than incidental surrounding context. We test this assumption in CNN-based agricultural image classification by comparing model performance on original images with performance on background-dominated patches extracted from the same images across eight publicly available agricultural benchmark datasets and four widely used CNN architectures. Background-dominated patches were classified above dataset-specific random chance for six of the eight datasets, and substantially above chance for four of them, indicating that contextual information contributes to model predictions for the majority of datasets evaluated. For these four datasets, we further evaluated whether this behavior reflected genuine class-discriminative information or was primarily attributable to class imbalance using macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 together with class-balanced test subsets. The results show that contextual reliance does not admit a single explanation: class imbalance accounts for a substantial portion of the observed signal for some datasets and architectures, whereas above-chance contextual classification persists after balancing for others. Together with previous evidence from curated object recognition and cancer pathology imaging, these findings support the growing view that contextual bias is a recurring characteristic of CNN-based image classification rather than a phenomenon confined to a single application domain. More broadly, this work provides a systematic framework for quantifying contextual bias across heterogeneous image datasets by combining dataset-specific random-chance baselines, contextual bias categorization, macro-averaged evaluation, and class-balanced robustness analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究在8个农业图像数据集和4种CNN架构上系统评估上下文偏差：通过对比原图与背景主导patch的分类性能，发现多数数据集上背景信息具有类别判别性，且其成因（类别不平衡或真实上下文线索）因数据集和架构而异。
AI.motivation: CNN评估通常依赖留出集分类准确率，隐含假设预测主要基于目标物体本身而非周围上下文。作者质疑该假设，并指出上下文偏差此前已在 curated 物体识别和癌症病理影像中被观察到，但尚缺乏跨异构数据集的系统性量化框架，尤其在农业图像分类这一领域。
AI.method: 在8个公开农业基准数据集和4种主流CNN架构上，将原图性能与从同一图像中提取的背景主导patch性能进行对比，并采用数据集特定的随机基线判定背景分类是否高于随机水平。对呈现显著背景效应的数据集，进一步用宏平均精确率、召回率、F1及类别平衡测试子集，区分该行为源于真实类别判别信息还是类别不平衡。
AI.result: 8个数据集中有6个的背景主导patch分类高于数据集特定随机水平，其中4个显著高于随机。对这4个数据集的分析表明，上下文依赖没有单一解释：部分数据集和架构中，类别不平衡解释了大部分观测信号；而在另一些情况下，类别平衡后仍存在高于随机的上下文分类能力。
AI.conclusion: 上下文偏差是CNN图像分类中反复出现的普遍特征，而非局限于某一应用领域。该工作提供了一个跨异构图像数据集量化上下文偏差的系统框架，结合数据集特定随机基线、上下文偏差分类、宏平均评估和类别平衡鲁棒性分析。

title: Compositional SVG Generation via VLM-Driven Hierarchical Semantic Parsing
comment: 26 pages, Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main)
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual reasoning, generating structured, editable Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) remains a fundamental challenge. Existing pipelines predominantly yield flat, semantically agnostic collections of paths, where editing a single object requires manually identifying its constituent paths. To address this, we propose a VLM-driven agentic framework for semantic compositional SVG generation. Our pipeline recursively parses visual scenes into semantic and geometric hierarchies via top-down decomposition, visual grounding, and prompt-driven amodal occlusion recovery, ensuring each component is geometrically complete. Furthermore, we introduce the Semantic SVG Benchmark with human-annotated semantic groups and novel sub-component metrics (Semantic Recall/Precision, PERE) to explicitly evaluate structural compositionality and functional editability. Experiments show that our natively predicted structures surpass the upper bounds of existing flat-generation methods in both grouping quality and editability, while maintaining state-of-the-art visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出VLM驱动的智能体框架，实现语义组合式SVG生成，将视觉场景递归解析为语义与几何层级，并配套提出语义SVG基准与子组件评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有SVG生成流程多产出扁平、无语义的路径集合，编辑单个对象需手动识别其构成路径，缺乏结构化与可编辑性。
AI.method: 采用自顶向下分解、视觉定位与提示驱动的非模态遮挡恢复，递归解析视觉场景为语义与几何层级，保证组件几何完整；并提出Semantic SVG Benchmark，含人工标注语义组及子组件指标（语义召回/精确率、PERE）。
AI.result: 原生预测的结构在分组质量与可编辑性上超越现有扁平生成方法的上限，同时保持最先进的视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 语义组合式SVG生成可行且优于扁平范式，所提基准与指标可显式评估结构组合性与功能可编辑性。

title: The Imitation Game: When LLMs Learn to Reason Like Programs via Code-Centric Reasoning Data Synthesis
comment: Accepted by EMNLP26 main
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at programming tasks but frequently fail at deterministic, fine-grained reasoning in natural language, relying heavily on semantic approximations rather than robust symbolic execution. To bridge this gap, we propose MIMIC, a framework that leverages executable code as a rigorous medium for reasoning data synthesis. MIMIC fundamentally transforms algorithms into verifiable reasoning trajectories through narrative fusion, code-guided test synthesis, and dynamic code instrumentation. Crucially, these explicit intermediate execution states naturally form a Code-Instrumented Reward (CIR), providing dense, high-fidelity process supervision for reinforcement learning without external reward models. Extensive evaluations reveal that models trained via SFT and GRPO on our synthesized dataset achieve substantial, consistent gains. Our method significantly elevates accuracy across general reasoning, complex mathematical benchmarks, and fine-grained deterministic tasks, demonstrating that the procedural rigor of executable code can effectively unlock and enhance the generalized reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/zjy1298/MIMIC.

AI.tldr: 提出 MIMIC 框架，以可执行代码为严谨媒介合成推理数据，通过叙事融合、代码引导测试合成与动态代码插桩生成可验证推理轨迹，并自然形成代码插桩奖励（CIR）用于密集过程监督，显著提升 LLM 的通用推理、数学与细粒度确定性任务准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM 在编程任务上表现优异，但在自然语言中做确定性、细粒度推理时频繁失败，主要依赖语义近似而非稳健的符号执行。作者希望借助可执行代码的过程严谨性来弥补这一差距，增强模型的泛化推理能力。
AI.method: 提出 MIMIC 框架，将算法转化为可验证的推理轨迹，包含三个关键环节：叙事融合（narrative fusion）、代码引导的测试合成（code-guided test synthesis）、动态代码插桩（dynamic code instrumentation）。插桩产生的显式中间执行状态构成代码插桩奖励（Code-Instrumented Reward, CIR），无需外部奖励模型即为强化学习提供密集、高保真的过程监督。模型在合成数据集上采用 SFT 与 GRPO 训练。
AI.result: 大量评估显示，经 SFT 与 GRPO 训练的模型取得显著且一致的性能提升，在通用推理、复杂数学基准以及细粒度确定性任务上的准确率均明显提高。
AI.conclusion: 可执行代码的过程严谨性能够有效解锁并增强 LLM 的泛化推理能力；代码与数据已开源（https://github.com/zjy1298/MIMIC）。

title: Exploring Multimodal Turn-Taking Cues in Face-to-Face Conversation using Voice Activity Projection
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Multimodal Interaction in Face-to-Face Dialogue (MINT)
summary: Turn-taking is a fundamental component of spoken interaction, and while humans naturally rely on both verbal and non-verbal signals, dialogue systems usually depend on audio cues alone. This paper investigates whether visual features from face-to-face conversations can enhance turn-taking prediction beyond what is achievable from audio-only. We extend the Voice Activity Projection (VAP) model, a self-supervised transformer-based model for predicting future voice activity, by incorporating visual features extracted from the large-scale Meta Seamless Interaction dataset of dyadic face-to-face conversations. The visual features include gaze direction, head movement, body and hand pose, and facial action units (FAU). For incorporating the visual features, we explore concatenation, cross-attention fusion, delta features, and trainable gating mechanisms. Results show that visual information improves performance over the audio-only baseline, with FAU being significantly more informative than other feature groups. Body and gaze features nevertheless contribute complementary information, as the model combining all features performs best. Furthermore, results indicate that performance on specific tasks varies depending on whether training and test data come from improvised (acted) or naturalistic (non-acted) conversations.

AI.tldr: 本文在VAP模型基础上引入视觉特征（注视、头部、身体/手部姿态、面部动作单元）来预测对话轮换，视觉信息优于纯音频基线，其中FAU信息量最大，融合全部特征效果最佳，且任务表现受即兴/自然对话类型影响。
AI.motivation: 轮换是口语交互的基本组成部分，人类自然依赖言语和非言语信号，但对话系统通常仅依赖音频线索。本文旨在探究面对面交谈中的视觉特征能否在纯音频之外提升轮换预测性能。
AI.method: 扩展Voice Activity Projection (VAP)模型——一种自监督的transformer未来语音活动预测模型，引入从大规模Meta Seamless Interaction双人面对面对话数据集提取的视觉特征，包括注视方向、头部运动、身体与手部姿态、面部动作单元(FAU)。融合方式探索了拼接、交叉注意力融合、delta特征和可训练门控机制。
AI.result: 视觉信息相比纯音频基线提升了性能，FAU显著比其他特征组更具信息量；身体和注视特征提供互补信息，融合所有特征的模型表现最佳。此外，在即兴（表演）与自然（非表演）对话上，训练和测试数据来源不同时，特定任务的表现存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 视觉特征能有效增强轮换预测，多模态融合（尤其包含FAU）最为有效；数据来源（即兴vs自然）对任务性能有调节作用，提示未来系统应重视多模态信号及对话类型的差异。

title: Floquet Fibre Geometry and Higher-Order Reduced Coordinates for Off-Manifold Transients near Nonlinear Aeroelastic Flutter
summary: Assigning reduced coordinates to states near an attracting limit cycle requires the correct invariant-fibre geometry. The classical first-order phase-isostable chart obtained from adjoint Floquet modes projects along the strong-stable quotient fibre, whereas a metric-orthogonal complement of the retained slow bundle generally does not. We prove locally that a chart satisfying the linearised semiconjugacy relation leaves an O(delta^2) invariance residual, while projection along a non-invariant complement generically leaves an O(delta) term. For a nonlinear aeroelastic limit cycle, the metric-normal and strong-stable directions differ by 48.5 to 71.7 degrees, and metric-normal perturbations contain first-order retained phase and slow-amplitude components. Replacing the metric normal by the strong-stable fibre changes the measured residual scaling from delta^1.01 to delta^1.87 without fitted parameters. We then test learned higher-order corrections whose linearisation is pinned to the adjoint-Floquet chart, whose symmetry is exact, and whose reduced flow is fixed. Although they reduce the registered fixed-normalisation latent residual, post-hoc amplitude recalibration and adjoint-Floquet-targeted future consistency move or reverse the ranking. Because the learned maps already share the baseline's first-order gauge and the future target is supplied by the baseline chart, these diagnostics establish neither an independent positive nor negative higher-order result. Correct first-order Floquet geometry is therefore necessary in this benchmark, while the additional predictive value of the learned correction remains unidentified by the available representation-dependent diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文证明：在吸引极限环附近降维时，正确的不变纤维几何至关重要。基于伴随Floquet模的相位-等时线图沿强稳定商纤维投影，残余为O(δ²)；沿非不变度量正交补投影则留下O(δ)项。非线性气动弹性极限环中两者相差48.5°–71.7°，切换纤维使残余标度从δ^1.01变为δ^1.87。所测试的学习式高阶修正诊断因表示依赖与基线共享一阶规范，无法给出确定性结论。
AI.motivation: 为极限环附近的降维动力学分配约化坐标，要求刻画正确的不变纤维几何。文献中常见做法是用度量正交补（如Gram-Schmidt）近似慢丛，但该方法是否保持不变性、是否引入低阶残余，缺乏明确的局部证明与可验证基准。作者希望建立一阶Floquet几何的必要性，并借此评估学习式高阶修正的真实预测价值。
AI.method: 局部理论证明：对比满足线性化半共轭关系的不变纤维图与非不变度量正交补投影，给出各自的 invariance residual 阶数（O(δ²) vs O(δ)）。数值实验：在一个非线性气动弹性极限环上，测量度量法向与强稳定纤维方向的夹角（48.5°–71.7°），检测度量法向扰动中的一阶相位与慢幅分量。基准对比：用强稳定纤维替换度量法向，无拟合参数地比较残余标度指数。学习式修正评估：训练线性化被固定到伴随-Floquet图、对称性精确、约化流固定的高阶修正，并考察固定归一化潜在残余、幅值后校准、与伴随-Floquet目标的一致性等表示依赖诊断。
AI.result: 理论上：线性化半共轭图残余为O(δ²)，非不变正交补投影一般留下O(δ)项。数值上：气动弹性极限环中度量法向与强稳定方向夹角达48.5°–71.7°，度量法向扰动含一阶保持相位与慢幅成分；采用强稳定纤维后残余标度指数由δ^1.01升至δ^1.87（无拟合参数）。学习式高阶修正虽降低固定归一化潜在残余，但幅值后校准与伴随-Floquet目标未来一致性检验会移动甚至反转排序，故无法确定其独立高阶贡献。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准中，正确的一阶Floquet几何（即沿不变强稳定纤维投影）是必需的，而度量正交补会引入一阶误差。至于学习式高阶修正是否具有额外预测价值，现有表示依赖的诊断（共享基线一阶规范、未来目标由基线图提供）既不能独立证实也不能否定，该问题仍待识别。因此需发展规范无关、表示独立的评估方法。

title: From Density to Biopsy Decisions and Malignancy Prediction: A Benchmark Study of Multimodal Large Language Models Against Radiologists in Digital and Contrast-Enhanced Mammography
comment: 37 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
summary: Purpose: To compare four multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with radiologists of varying expertise in breast density assessment, BI-RADS assessment, biopsy candidacy determination, and continuous malignancy probability estimation using digital mammography (DM) and contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM). Methods: This study included 179 women with paired DM/CEM examinations and reference standards. Four MLLMs (ChatGPT-5.2, Gemini-3.1 Pro, Sonnet-4.6, Muse Spark) interpreted images with and without masks; three radiologists interpreted non-masked images. Results: For binary density classification on DM, radiologist accuracies ranged from 55.81% to 78.60%, exceeding most MLLM values (62.33%-71.63%), while masks added limited benefit. Five-category BI-RADS accuracies were higher for radiologists on DM (56.74-67.44%) and CEM (62.33-82.79%) compared with MLLMs (DM 31.16-45.12%; CEM 40.00-55.81%). Binary biopsy-candidacy accuracies were likewise higher for radiologists (DM 85.12-89.77%; CEM 86.98-92.09%) than for MLLMs (DM 61.39-75.35%; CEM 69.30-82.79%), although CEM improved performance across all readers. Lesion masks substantially improved MLLM continuous malignancy-probability accuracies from 64.65%-71.63% to 72.56-78.60% on DM and from 67.91%-77.21% to 72.56%-81.86% on CEM, approaching radiologist ranges (DM 63.72-82.79%; CEM 81.86-88.84%). The corresponding AUCs for the top masked models overlapped those of the human readers. Overall, Muse Spark, followed by Sonnet-4.6, demonstrated the strongest performance among the MLLMs across domains. Conclusion: Radiologists generally outperformed MLLMs in categorical tasks, while selected masked models approached human performance for continuous malignancy probability estimation, suggesting a potential adjunctive role.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比四种多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与不同经验水平放射科医师在乳腺密度、BI-RADS、活检指征及恶性概率估计上的表现，结果显示放射科医师在分类任务中总体优于MLLMs，而经病灶掩膜增强的MLLMs在连续恶性概率估计上接近人类水平。
AI.motivation: 评估多模态大语言模型在数字乳腺摄影（DM）与对比增强乳腺摄影（CEM）临床判读中的能力边界，明确其相对放射科医师的差距与互补潜力，为其潜在的辅助应用定位提供依据。
AI.method: 纳入179例配对的DM/CEM检查及参考标准。四种MLLMs（ChatGPT-5.2、Gemini-3.1 Pro、Sonnet-4.6、Muse Spark）分别在有无病灶掩膜条件下判读图像；三名放射科医师仅判读无掩膜图像。比较指标包括二分类乳腺密度、五分类BI-RADS、二分类活检指征及连续恶性概率估计（含AUC）。
AI.result: DM二分类密度：医师准确率55.81%–78.60%，多数高于MLLMs（62.33%–71.63%），掩膜增益有限。五分类BI-RADS：医师在DM（56.74%–67.44%）与CEM（62.33%–82.79%）均高于MLLMs（DM 31.16%–45.12%；CEM 40.00%–55.81%）。二分类活检指征：医师（DM 85.12%–89.77%；CEM 86.98%–92.09%）高于MLLMs（DM 61.39%–75.35%；CEM 69.30%–82.79%），且CEM使所有读者性能提升。病灶掩膜显著提升MLLM连续恶性概率估计准确率：DM由64.65%–71.63%升至72.56%–78.60%，CEM由67.91%–77.21%升至72.56%–81.86%，接近医师区间（DM 63.72%–82.79%；CEM 81.86%–88.84%）；最优掩膜模型的AUC与人类读者重叠。MLLMs中Muse Spark表现最佳，其次为Sonnet-4.6。
AI.conclusion: 放射科医师在分类任务中总体优于MLLMs；经病灶掩膜增强的特定模型在连续恶性概率估计上接近人类表现，提示MLLMs可能具备辅助判读的潜在价值。

title: The Garden of Forking Prompts: How Users Explore Narrative Space in Story Generation
comment: Accepted at COLM 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have changed the way people engage with stories. Drawing on public chatbot logs, we can see that when users generate stories, they iteratively edit their prompts to explore narrative possibilities, adjusting characters, redirecting plots, and swapping fictional universes. As aggregated data, these prompts represent rich traces of creative preference at scale. Yet story generation evaluation benchmarks rely on static, one-shot prompts that cannot capture this exploratory behavior. In this work, we study how users revise consecutive story prompts in the wild. Using a dataset of naturally occurring user-chatbot conversations, we construct WildStories, a sample of 275,635 story generation prompts (labeled with story format, prompt components, and explicitness), and WildEdits, a collection of 24,291 edit trees that model how users iteratively edit base story prompts and explore branching story possibilities. From these trees we develop a framework of edit types crossing four directions (adding, removing, changing, and extending) with fourteen targets (e.g., plot, character, genre). We then use our datasets and this framework to analyze user behavior in navigating narrative space via LLMs. Finally, we show how automated permutations based on the framework can be used for story generation benchmarking. Content Warning: This paper works with "wild" chatbot logs, which often include toxic and sexually explicit themes.

AI.tldr: 论文基于真实聊天机器人日志构建 WildStories（275,635 条故事生成提示）与 WildEdits（24,291 棵编辑树），提出跨越 4 个方向、14 个目标（如情节、角色、类型）的编辑类型框架，用以分析用户如何借助 LLM 迭代探索叙事空间，并将该框架用于故事生成基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有故事生成评测基准依赖静态、一次性提示，无法反映用户在真实场景中通过迭代修改提示来探索叙事可能性（调整角色、改变情节、替换世界观）的行为。而公开聊天机器人日志中汇聚的提示恰恰蕴含大规模创意偏好痕迹，因此需要刻画并利用这种"野外"迭代编辑行为。
AI.method: 1) 使用自然发生的用户-聊天机器人对话数据，构建 WildStories 数据集，包含 275,635 条故事生成提示，并按故事格式、提示组件、显式程度进行标注；2) 构建 WildEdits，包含 24,291 棵编辑树，建模用户如何迭代编辑基础故事提示并探索分支叙事可能性；3) 从编辑树中归纳出编辑类型框架，涵盖四个方向（添加、删除、修改、扩展）与十四个目标（如情节、角色、类型）；4) 基于框架进行自动排列组合，用于故事生成基准测试。
AI.result: 构建了 WildStories（275,635 条提示）和 WildEdits（24,291 棵编辑树）两个数据集，并提出了 4 方向 × 14 目标的编辑类型框架；基于该框架分析了用户在 LLM 中探索叙事空间的行为，并验证了基于框架的自动排列可用于故事生成基准测试。
AI.conclusion: 用户的真实故事生成是迭代式、探索性的，静态一次性提示的评测方式存在局限；通过大规模野外提示数据与编辑类型框架，可以刻画并量化这种叙事空间探索行为，同时为更贴近真实使用场景的故事生成评测提供可自动生成的新基准方法。

title: One Feedback System Does Not Fit All: Localising Data-to-Text Driver Coaching for the United Kingdom and Nigeria
comment: Accepted to INLG 2026
summary: Data-to-text driver coaching is often presented as a generic pipeline from telematics events to advice. This paper argues that its content requires localisation because usefulness and credibility depend on drivers' knowledge, prevalent risks, regulation, infrastructure, and available data. Two independently developed systems in the United Kingdom and Nigeria are compared by tracing requirements through content selection, generation, and field evaluation. The UK system prioritises post-trip reflection, explanations tied to road and place context, and tone-sensitive wording. The Nigerian system combines legally grounded, once-daily Tips based on detected events with weekly persuasive Reports; it foregrounds safety education and alcohol-related risk in response to reported gaps in formal training and traffic-rule knowledge, as well as local road-safety priorities. Reliable speed-limit metadata supported speeding feedback in the UK, whereas its scarcity led the Nigerian evaluation to exclude speeding from its outcome metric. Both interventions were associated with reduced distance-normalised unsafe-event rates in their own field studies, although their designs and metrics preclude an effect-size comparison. The analysis yields a requirements-to-content design process for localising safety-critical NLG without treating a high-income deployment as the default.

AI.tldr: 数据到文本的驾驶教练内容需要本地化，本文通过对比英国与尼日利亚两套独立开发系统，提出面向安全关键型自然语言生成的"需求到内容"本地化设计流程。
AI.motivation: 作者认为驾驶教练内容的实用性与可信度取决于驾驶者的知识水平、当地主要风险、法规、基础设施与可用数据，因此不能将数据到文本的驾驶教练视为通用流水线，也不应把高收入国家的部署当作默认范式。
AI.method: 对比英国与尼日利亚两套独立开发的数据到文本系统，沿需求分析、内容选择、文本生成与实地评估四个环节追溯设计决策；结合两地法规、风险优先级与数据可得性（如限速元数据）解释差异。
AI.result: 英国系统侧重行程后反思、结合道路与地点情境的解释以及语气敏感的措辞；尼日利亚系统将基于检测事件、具有法律依据的每日提示与每周说服性报告相结合，突出安全教育和酒精相关风险。英国限速元数据可靠，支持超速反馈；尼日利亚因该数据稀缺而在评估指标中排除超速。两项干预在各自实地研究中均与距离归一化不安全事件率下降相关，但设计与指标不同，无法比较效应量。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了一套将需求映射到内容的本地化设计流程，用于安全关键型自然语言生成，避免以高收入部署为默认参照。

title: LIMODENet: Attention-Free Compact Encoders for Information-Preserving Onboard Satellite Image Restoration
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; includes supplementary material with full proofs. Code and weights: https://github.com/ltdung/limodenet and https://huggingface.co/ltdung/limodenet
summary: Onboard satellites must restore a channel-degraded image on a few watts, using neuromorphic accelerators (e.g., BrainChip Akida, Intel Loihi-2) that support no softmax or attention. We ask which encoder restores best under that constraint and introduce LIMODENet (LinearMix-ODENet), a 0.69M softmax-/QKV-free backbone whose residual stages read as ODE discretizations and which is empirically information-preserving (probe accuracy rises 79.9% -> 98.4% from stem to head). At iso-parameters it restores 1 dB DVB-S2X-degraded EuroSAT better than a CNN autoencoder (+1.75 dB PSNR) and a skip-connection U-Net (+1.07 dB), three seeds, non-overlapping. Unconstrained modern restorers (NAFNet, Restormer) win on fidelity; we decompose that gap: spiking-legal additive skips recover about half, and the rest traces to attention and channel gating. LIMODENet then converts end-to-end to a spiking network with zero blocked operations, versus 22-24 for the competitors: not the best restorer available, but the best verified deployable within a real power budget.

AI.tldr: 提出LIMODENet（LinearMix-ODENet），一种0.69M参数、无需softmax/QKV的骨干网络，用于在神经形态加速器约束下恢复退化图像。
AI.motivation: 在轨卫星需在几瓦功耗预算下，依靠不支持softmax或attention的神经形态加速器恢复信道退化图像，因此需要研究在该约束下哪种编码器恢复效果最佳。
AI.method: 引入LIMODENet，其残差阶段可解释为ODE离散化，且经验上信息保持（从stem到head探针准确率由79.9%升至98.4%）；并在等参数条件下与CNN自编码器、带跳连U-Net对比。
AI.result: 等参数下，LIMODENet对DVB-S2X退化的EuroSAT恢复比CNN自编码器高+1.75 dB PSNR、比跳连U-Net高+1.07 dB，三个随机种子均不重叠；NAFNet、Restormer在保真度上更优，该差距约一半来自spiking合法的加性跳连，其余源于attention与通道门控；LIMODENet可端到端转换为脉冲网络，零阻塞操作，而竞品有22-24个阻塞操作。
AI.conclusion: LIMODENet并非现有最佳恢复器，但是在真实功耗预算内经过验证的最佳可部署方案。

title: Speak to the City: Multimodal Resolution for Outside-the-Vehicle References
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 1 table; Accepted to the 18th International ACM Conference on Automotive User Interfaces and Interactive Vehicular Applications (AutoUI '26)
summary: As autonomous vehicles and Extended Reality (XR) headsets enable novel in-car interactions, seamlessly querying physical landmarks, known as Outside-the-Vehicle Referencing (OVR), remains challenging due to ego-motion and referential ambiguity. We present a robust, multimodal OVR framework fusing user gaze and natural language to identify Points of Interest (POIs). To address the scarcity of dynamic vehicular data, we developed a VR-based pipeline synchronizing 360-degree transit videos with vehicle GNSS telemetry. Through a user study (N=46) mapping passenger head orientation into a 3D geospatial Digital Twin, we captured authentic gaze-speech behaviors. We subsequently trained a lightweight Transformer network, leveraging LLMs to dynamically align continuous spatial gaze vectors with discrete verbal context. Experimental results demonstrate high accuracy and low computational overhead, achieving an 83.33% Top-1 accuracy (87.72% Top-2) and an average inference time of 24.3 milliseconds. This real-time paradigm effectively resolves referential ambiguity, enabling context-aware spatial retrieval for passengers within the vehicle.

AI.tldr: 提出融合视线与自然语言的多模态车外参照(OVR)框架，通过VR数据采集管道与轻量Transformer实现POI实时识别，Top-1准确率83.33%，平均推理24.3毫秒。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶与XR头显带来新型车内交互，但车辆自身运动(ego-motion)与指代歧义使乘客无缝查询车外物理地标(OVR)仍然困难；同时动态车载场景数据稀缺。
AI.method: 构建基于VR的数据采集管道，将360度公交/行进视频与车辆GNSS遥测同步；通过用户研究(N=46)把乘客头部朝向映射到3D地理空间数字孪生中，采集真实凝视-语音行为；训练轻量Transformer网络，利用LLM动态对齐连续空间凝视向量与离散语言上下文。
AI.result: 实现高准确率与低计算开销：Top-1准确率83.33%，Top-2准确率87.72%，平均推理时间24.3毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 该实时范式有效消解指代歧义，可为车内乘客提供上下文感知的空间检索能力。

title: Perceive, Refine, Reason: A Calibrated Pipeline for Measuring Indicators in Strategic Visual Communication on Social Media
summary: Visual content shapes audience perception and opinion on social media, and computational social science increasingly relies on automated tools to analyze images at scale. Yet a measurement gap persists: existing tools rely on predefined categories or produce only coarse image-level labels, while measuring which specific objects appear in an image, how prominently, and where in the frame remains difficult at scale. We introduce Perceive, Refine, Reason (PRR), a calibrated pipeline that turns flexible vision-language detectors into auditable measurement instruments for social-scientific research. PRR combines natural-language category prompts with pixel-level spatial refinement via the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and a multimodal LLM arbitration layer whose reasoning chains externalize domain knowledge and lower the expertise threshold for human-in-the-loop validation. A complementary three-tier auditability framework applies quantification learning to profile per-category reliability, support task-aligned configuration, and statistically correct prevalence estimates. Across four vision-language detectors and nine sociological categories, the pipeline yields substantial precision gains over zero-shot baselines, including a 43.3-point improvement for the strongest backbone. Applying PRR to 103,920 Facebook images from U.S. legislators during the 2024 election cycle and linking detections to DW-NOMINATE ideology scores, we find that more conservative legislators display U.S. flags as larger visual elements, with a weaker tendency toward peripheral placement, a spatial pattern invisible to binary detection. PRR provides computational social scientists with a model-agnostic toolkit for accessible, spatially-grounded, and correctable visual measurement.

AI.tldr: PRR 是一套可校准的视觉测量流水线，将视觉-语言检测器转变为可审计的社会科学研究工具，实现类别级、含空间信息的图像测量。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体视觉内容影响受众认知，计算社会科学亟需大规模图像分析工具；但现有工具依赖预定义类别或仅输出粗粒度图像级标签，难以大规模测量"哪些物体出现、显著性如何、位于画面何处"，形成测量缺口。
AI.method: 提出 Perceive, Refine, Reason (PRR) 流水线：自然语言类别提示驱动视觉-语言检测器；用 SAM 做像素级空间精修；多模态 LLM 仲裁层通过推理链外化领域知识、降低人工在环验证门槛。配套三层可审计框架，用定量学习刻画各类别可靠性、支持任务对齐配置并统计校正流行度估计。
AI.result: 在四种视觉-语言检测器与九个社会学类别上，精度较零样本基线显著提升，最强骨干提升 43.3 个百分点。应用于 2024 选举周期 103,920 张美国议员 Facebook 图像并关联 DW-NOMINATE 意识形态分数，发现更保守议员展示的美国国旗视觉尺寸更大、边缘放置倾向更弱——该空间模式在二值检测中不可见。
AI.conclusion: PRR 为计算社会科学家提供了模型无关的工具包，支持易用、空间落地且可校正的视觉测量。

title: Patient-Level, Leakage-Aware Deep Learning for Cross-Center Periapical Radiograph Classification
comment: Submitted to the 9th International Conference on Signal Processing and Information Security (ICSPIS 2026)
summary: Dental caries and endodontic disease are among the most common health conditions worldwide, and intraoral periapical radiographs are central to their detection, treatment planning, and follow-up. Automated tooth-level classification of these images, however, lacks reproducible benchmarks, is often evaluated with image-level splits that leak patients between training and test, and is rarely validated across clinics. This paper presents the first patient-level, leakage-aware classification benchmark for single-tooth intraoral periapical radiographs on the DentIRO dataset, which comprises 5,300 images from 3,243 patients across two clinics and four classes: Healthy, Caries, Crowned, and Root Canal. Five transfer-learning models are compared with patient-grouped stratified cross-validation, so that every patient remains within a single fold. DenseNet121 gave the strongest and most stable result at a mean macro-F1 of 0.9787, while the four ImageNet-initialized backbones performed comparably. A controlled comparison on a fixed architecture showed that chest-radiograph pretraining transferred less effectively than ImageNet initialization. Bidirectional cross-center validation produced a small average generalization gap of 0.0077, and Grad-CAM confirmed that predictions rely on clinically meaningful tooth regions rather than acquisition artifacts. The benchmark offers a rigorous and reproducible baseline for intraoral radiograph classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个患者级、防泄漏的单牙口内根尖片分类基准（DentIRO，5,300张、3,243名患者、两中心、四类别），用患者分组分层交叉验证比较五种迁移学习模型，DenseNet121取得最佳且最稳定的macro-F1 0.9787，跨中心泛化差距仅0.0077。
AI.motivation: 龋病与牙髓病极为常见，口内根尖片在其检测、治疗规划与随访中至关重要；然而现有自动化牙齿级分类缺乏可复现基准，常采用图像级划分导致患者信息在训练与测试间泄漏，且鲜有跨诊所验证。
AI.method: 构建DentIRO数据集（两诊所、3,243名患者、5,300张单牙根尖片，四类：Healthy、Caries、Crowned、Root Canal）；采用患者分组分层交叉验证确保同一患者仅出现在单一折内；比较五种迁移学习模型；在固定架构上进行受控预训练来源对比（胸部X线预训练 vs. ImageNet初始化）；开展双向跨中心验证；用Grad-CAM进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: DenseNet121表现最强且最稳定，平均macro-F1为0.9787；四个ImageNet初始化骨干网络表现相当；受控实验显示胸部X线预训练的迁移效果弱于ImageNet初始化；双向跨中心验证平均泛化差距仅0.0077；Grad-CAM表明预测依据临床有意义的牙齿区域而非采集伪影。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为口内根尖片分类提供了严谨、可复现的基线，确立了患者级防泄漏评估与跨中心验证的规范。

title: Depth and Scale in the Sub-150M Regime: JugnuLM-53M vs JugnuLM-110M
summary: We scale our conventional sub-150M pretraining recipe from 53.5M to 109.7M parameters, holding the method fixed (Qwen3-style decoder with grouped-query attention, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, QK-Norm, and a z-loss; FineWeb-Edu data) and changing only the geometry to a deep-and-thin 23-layer x 576-hidden design. The larger model improves across the board -- BLiMP 78.1 -> 81.3, ARC-Easy 51.4 -> 52.5, WikiText-2 byte-perplexity 2.04 -> 1.95 -- and its 81.3% BLiMP essentially matches GPT-X2-125M (81.28) at about 12% fewer parameters. Notably the 110M model achieves this on fewer training tokens (about 8B vs 12B), so the gain is attributable to capacity and depth, not more data. Both models are deliberately conventional; this report is a clean scaling control and the baseline rung (R0) of an ablation study of what further improves models in this regime. An ablation ladder follows: value residuals (R1) and the Muon optimizer (R2) lift ARC-Easy by a cumulative +3.6 (52.5 -> 56.1) at a near-flat BLiMP and are kept; a diverse data blend (R3) and two logit-distillation settings (R4a/R4b) are not kept -- honest negatives. R3 pins ARC-Easy to FineWeb-Edu's educational filtering rather than raw diversity; distillation from a 1.7B teacher can reach the class-leading ARC-Easy (56.99, matching GPT-X2-125M) but only at a perplexity cost that dialing KD down then erases -- so R2 remains the best kept stack.

AI.tldr: 将固定配方的小模型从53.5M扩展到109.7M（23层×576隐藏深窄结构），全面超越基线并在更少训练token下接近GPT-X2-125M；随后通过消融阶梯发现值残差+Muon（R1+R2）是最佳保留方案，数据混合与蒸馏未被采纳。
AI.motivation: 探索在亚150M参数的小模型区间内，单纯的规模扩展（容量与深度）能带来多少收益，并建立一个干净的扩展控制基线（R0），作为后续"该区间内何种改进有效"的消融研究起点。
AI.method: 保持预训练配方固定（Qwen3风格解码器：分组查询注意力、RoPE、SwiGLU、RMSNorm、QK-Norm、z-loss；FineWeb-Edu数据），仅将几何结构改为深窄的23层×576隐藏、参数量从53.5M增至109.7M。在此基础上搭建消融阶梯：R1值残差、R2 Muon优化器、R3多样数据混合、R4a/R4b两种logit蒸馏设置。
AI.result: 110M模型全面提升：BLiMP 78.1→81.3、ARC-Easy 51.4→52.5、WikiText-2字节困惑度2.04→1.95，其81.3% BLiMP基本匹配GPT-X2-125M（81.28）且参数约少12%，训练token更少（约8B vs 12B）。R1+R2累计提升ARC-Easy +3.6（52.5→56.1）且BLiMP近乎持平，被保留；R3和R4a/R4b未被保留。R3说明ARC-Easy受FineWeb-Edu教育过滤而非原始多样性限制；从1.7B教师蒸馏可达56.99（匹配GPT-X2-125M）但伴随困惑度代价，调低KD后该增益消失。
AI.conclusion: 在小模型区间，容量与深度是增益主因而非更多数据；值残差加Muon（R2）构成最佳保留栈，数据混合与蒸馏为诚实的负面结果。

title: PC$^2$-AD: Point Cloud Upsampling to Safeguard 3D Anomaly Detection with Resolution-constrained Edge Devices
comment: 17 pages, including 6 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/gyutong406-commits/PC2-AD
summary: Low-cost and low-resolution sensors used in edge deployments can produce test point clouds that are substantially sparser than the normal training data. This train-test sampling-resolution gap changes the local geometry available to a 3D anomaly detector. We propose PC$^2$-AD, a point cloud upsampling framework that compensates sparse test inputs before downstream detection. Target Domain Candidate Generation (TCG) adapts a pretrained upsampler to normal training geometry and generates a dense candidate pool. Geometry-Aware Candidate Filtering (GACF) selects candidates according to geometric spacing and spatial coverage. Normality-Preserving Point Compensation (NPPC) refines the selection by comparing candidate normality scores with those of their input anchors. The selected points are combined with the unchanged input points and processed by the existing detector. Experiments with six detectors on two Anomaly-ShapeNet settings and Real3D-AD show improvements in the mean of object-level and point-level AUROC for all six detectors in each Anomaly-ShapeNet setting and four on Real3D-AD. These results support point cloud compensation as an input-level approach to improving 3D anomaly detection under low-resolution sensing conditions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/gyutong406-commits/PC2-AD.

AI.tldr: 提出PC²-AD点云上采样框架，通过测试端稀疏输入补偿提升3D异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 边缘部署中的低成本、低分辨率传感器产生的测试点云明显比正常训练数据稀疏，这种训练-测试采样分辨率差距改变了3D异常检测器可用的局部几何信息，导致检测性能下降。
AI.method: PC²-AD包含三个模块：目标域候选生成（TCG）将预训练上采样器适配到正常训练几何并生成稠密候选池；几何感知候选过滤（GACF）依据几何间距和空间覆盖筛选候选点；法向保持点补偿（NPPC）通过比较候选点与输入锚点的正常性得分精炼选择。选定点与未改变的输入点结合后输入现有检测器。
AI.result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet的两种设置和Real3D-AD上对六种检测器进行实验：每个Anomaly-ShapeNet设置中六种检测器的对象级与点级AUROC均值均有提升，Real3D-AD上有四种检测器提升。
AI.conclusion: 点云补偿作为一种输入级方法，可有效改善低分辨率传感条件下的3D异常检测性能。代码已公开。

title: CrossDistill: Balancing Quality and Diversity via Trajectory-Level Hybrid Few-Step Distillation
summary: Few-step distillation accelerates diffusion models but must balance diversity and fidelity: trajectory-based distillation preserves mode coverage, while distribution matching sharpens samples but can reduce diversity. We show that this tension can be exploited in a noise-regime-dependent way: high-noise steps largely determine global modes, whereas low-noise steps refine local details. We propose CrossDistill, a trajectory-level hybrid distillation framework that splits the sampling trajectory at a crossover point, applies a trajectory-preserving objective on the high-noise interval and a distribution-matching objective on the low-noise interval, and couples the two stages through the crossover state. In contrast to loss-level mixing, and complementarily to training-time two-stage recipes, CrossDistill explicitly assigns complementary objectives along the noise axis, so that global branching is preserved before local statistics are sharpened. CrossDistill is a noise-level scheduling policy: PCM and DMD are plug-in instantiations, while the noise partition, crossover coupling, and objective ordering are the key design elements. Experiments on text-to-video diffusion models and qualitative image-to-video results show that CrossDistill expands the few-step quality-diversity frontier, retaining seed-level variation while achieving competitive visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: CrossDistill提出一种轨迹级混合蒸馏框架，在采样轨迹的交叉点处切分：高噪声区间用轨迹保持目标、低噪声区间用分布匹配目标，并通过交叉状态耦合两阶段，从而在少步蒸馏中同时改善多样性与保真度。
AI.motivation: 少步蒸馏需在多样性与保真度之间权衡：基于轨迹的蒸馏保留模态覆盖，而分布匹配使样本更锐利但可能降低多样性。作者希望挖掘这一张力在噪声区间依赖性下的可利用性——高噪声步主要决定全局模态，低噪声步精炼局部细节。
AI.method: 提出CrossDistill：一种轨迹级混合蒸馏框架。将采样轨迹在交叉点处分割，高噪声区间施加轨迹保持目标，低噪声区间施加分布匹配目标，并通过交叉状态耦合两个阶段。区别于损失层面的混合，也补充于训练时的两阶段配方，该方法沿噪声轴显式分配互补目标，使全局分支在局部统计被锐化之前得到保留。CrossDistill是一种噪声级调度策略，PCM与DMD作为即插即用实例，噪声划分、交叉耦合与目标排序是核心设计要素。
AI.result: 在文本到视频扩散模型上的实验以及定性的图像到视频结果表明，CrossDistill扩展了少步质量-多样性前沿，在保持种子级变化的同时取得有竞争力的视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过沿噪声轴显式分配互补蒸馏目标并耦合交叉状态，CrossDistill以噪声级调度策略的形式缓解了少步蒸馏中多样性与保真度的张力，为少步生成提供了可扩展的框架。

title: CALICO: A Human-Centered, Codebook-Aligned System for Annotation
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to scale codebook-based annotation in scientific research, but existing workflows provide limited support for translating domain experts' codebooks into reliable, revisable, and auditable prompts. Prompts are often treated as fixed instructions and hidden from annotators, making it difficult for non-technical domain experts to diagnose and correct model behavior when outputs violate codebook guidelines. In this paper, we present CALICO, a human-centered, codebook-aligned annotation workflow that treats prompts as editable, versioned, and optimizable artifacts. CALICO integrates codebook parsing, prompt generation, result inspection, prompt versioning, natural language human feedback, and label-supervised prompt optimization through existing optimizers such as GEPA, MIPROv2, and OPRO, together with our reflection-based optimizer, ReflectAgent. Empirically, we evaluate CALICO on domain-specific AI-companion chatbot conversation codebooks. Across evaluated dimensions, CALICO improves mean held-out performance by +13.0 and +7.4 absolute points for two coders, respectively. A coder-specificity analysis further suggests that optimized prompts capture coder-specific interpretations rather than only generic codebook clarification. CALICO runs as a web application that takes users from raw codebook materials to inspectable, exportable labels; the website, codebase, and live demo are released at https://calico-annotation.github.io/ under the Apache 2.0 License.

AI.tldr: CALICO 是一个以人为中心、对齐码本的标注工作流，将提示视为可编辑、可版本化、可优化的工件，支持码本解析、提示生成、结果检查、版本管理与基于人类反馈和标签监督的优化。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多用于扩展科研中基于码本的标注，但现有工作流难以把领域专家的码本转化为可靠、可修订、可审计的提示；提示常被当作固定指令并对标注者隐藏，导致非技术背景的领域专家在模型输出违背码本准则时难以诊断和纠正模型行为。
AI.method: CALICO 整合了码本解析、提示生成、结果检查、提示版本化、自然语言人类反馈，以及标签监督的提示优化；优化器采用 GEPA、MIPROv2、OPRO，并加入作者提出的基于反思的优化器 ReflectAgent。系统以网页应用形式运行，覆盖从原始码本材料到可检查、可导出标签的全流程。
AI.result: 在领域特定的 AI 伴侣聊天机器人对话码本上进行实证评估，在两个评估维度上，CALICO 分别为两名编码者将留出集平均性能提升 +13.0 与 +7.4 个绝对百分点；编码者特异性分析进一步表明，优化后的提示捕捉到了编码者特定的解读，而不仅是通用的码本澄清。网站、代码库与在线演示已在 https://calico-annotation.github.io/ 以 Apache 2.0 许可发布。
AI.conclusion: CALICO 证明了将提示作为可编辑、可版本化、可优化工件并以人类反馈与标签监督进行优化的可行性与有效性，能够帮助非技术领域专家诊断和纠正模型行为，并保留编码者特定的解释，为可扩展且可审计的码本标注提供了工具支撑。

title: Building Legal Reward Models for Grounding and Abstention
comment: Published at ICML 2026 AI4Law Workshop
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in high-stakes domains such as law, where systems must ground their reasoning in retrieved evidence and abstain when that evidence is insufficient. However, existing reward models are largely optimised for general preferences rather than contextual grounding, limiting their ability to evaluate these behaviours in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) settings. We introduce a framework for transforming existing legal QA datasets into contextual preference data and use it to construct LegalRewardBench (LRB), a benchmark for evaluating grounded legal generation under noisy and insufficient retrieval conditions. Across general and legal contextual evaluation, we find that contextual DPO improves grounded evaluation, but performance is sensitive to preference-data construction. Length-balanced augmentation substantially improves grounded legal evaluation, with the strongest configuration combining length-balanced legal and general contextual preference data and improving performance by up to $\mathbf{+25.6}$pp over baseline. We further find evidence of cross-jurisdiction transfer: models contextually refined primarily on Victorian criminal-law data improve grounded evaluation on external US legal benchmarks, including a $\mathbf{+16.2}$pp improvement on \textsc{Housing Statute QA}. Together, these results provide a reproducible foundation for constructing and evaluating grounded legal reward models in retrieval-augmented settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出构建情境化偏好数据的框架，用于训练和评估检索增强生成（RAG）下的法律领域奖励模型，并发布 LegalRewardBench 基准。实验表明情境化 DPO 能提升有据可循的评估能力，性能对偏好数据构造方式敏感；长度均衡增强结合法律与通用情境偏好数据可将性能提升最多 +25.6pp，并观察到跨法域迁移效应（在美国住房法规问答上 +16.2pp）。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益应用于法律等高利害领域，此类系统必须将推理建立在检索到的证据之上，并在证据不足时弃答（abstain）。然而现有奖励模型主要针对通用偏好优化，而非情境化依据（contextual grounding），难以评估 RAG 场景下的上述行为。因此需要一个可复现的、面向有据法律生成的评估与训练基础。
AI.method: 提出一个将现有法律问答数据集转化为情境化偏好数据的框架，并据此构建 LegalRewardBench（LRB）——一个在噪声与不充分检索条件下评估有据法律生成的基准。在此基础上采用情境化 DPO（contextual DPO）训练奖励模型，并研究偏好数据构造的影响，包括长度均衡增强（length-balanced augmentation）以及法律与通用情境偏好数据的组合。
AI.result: 在通用与法律情境化评估中，情境化 DPO 提升了有据评估表现，但性能对偏好数据构造方式敏感；长度均衡增强显著改善有据法律评估，最优配置为长度均衡的法律+通用情境偏好数据组合，较基线最高提升 +25.6pp。还发现跨法域迁移证据：主要用维多利亚州刑法数据情境化优化的模型，在外部美国法律基准上有据评估有所提升，其中 Housing Statute QA 提升 +16.2pp。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在检索增强场景下构建与评估有据法律奖励模型提供了可复现的基础；偏好数据的构造方式（尤其是长度均衡与数据混合）对情境化偏好优化效果至关重要，且情境化优化能力具有一定跨法域迁移性。

title: Quantifying the Generation Modality Gap in Speech-Text Language Models
comment: Accepted to SLT 2026, extended version with appendix
summary: Pure speech language models often lag behind text and speech-text language models in generating coherent content, but this gap is difficult to quantify because speech and text systems are typically evaluated with different metrics and trained on different data. We study the speech-text modality gap in a family of spoken language models, based on flow matching for continuous acoustic feature generation. We construct a unified generation-based evaluation suite that compares speech-only, text-only, and speech-text language models trained on matched data distributions and evaluated in matched generation settings. We evaluate generated continuations along multiple dimensions: semantic coherence, measured by transcribing generated speech and scoring it with a reference language model; local phonetic structure, measured by phone n-gram distributional statistics; speaker consistency and acoustic quality; and emotion-based distributional metrics. Across datasets, we find that joint speech-text modeling substantially improves semantic coherence. However, the improvement is not uniform across metrics: phone-level metrics change only modestly, speaker similarity and predicted quality are lower for speech-text continuations, while emotion-based distributional metrics improve. Compared with larger-scale speech-only models, our speech-text model closes much of the scaling gap in transcript-based semantic coherence, suggesting that text provides an efficient semantic training signal for spoken language modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过统一评测框架研究语音-文本模态差距，发现联合建模显著提升语义连贯性，但各指标改善不均衡。
AI.motivation: 纯语音语言模型的生成连贯性常落后于文本及语音-文本模型，但该差距难以量化，因为二者通常采用不同指标、不同训练数据。作者希望构建匹配训练分布与匹配生成设置的统一评测，以厘清语音-文本模态差距的具体来源。
AI.method: 基于flow matching的连续声学特征生成，构建一族口语语言模型，包括纯语音、纯文本、语音-文本三种，在匹配数据分布与匹配生成设置下训练与评测。构建统一的基于生成的评测套件，从多维度量生成的续写内容：语义连贯性（转写生成语音并用参考语言模型打分）、局部音素结构（音素n-gram分布统计）、说话人一致性与声学质量、以及基于情感的分布指标。
AI.result: 跨数据集上，联合语音-文本建模显著提升语义连贯性；但改善不均匀：音素级指标仅小幅变化，语音-文本续写的说话人相似度与预测质量更低，而基于情感的分布指标有所提升。与更大规模纯语音模型相比，该语音-文本模型在基于转写的语义连贯性上弥合了大部分规模差距。
AI.conclusion: 文本为口语语言建模提供了高效的语义训练信号；语音-文本模态差距在不同维度上表现各异，需采用多维统一评测才能准确衡量。

title: Calibrating Interpretability Instruments Before Trusting Their Verdicts
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Companion to "Refusal Reads Only a Slice of What the Model Knows" (submitted concurrently). Per-unit arrays: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22731361. Code: https://github.com/deepsteer/deepsteer
summary: Causal claims about large language model (LLM) internals rest on measurements. Those might include a projection, a cosine, an ablation delta, or an interchange patch among others. These measurements fail in specific, diagnosable ways that return a plausible number instead of an error, so a broken instrument can easily read as a finding. A covariance-matched null can saturate until every direction looks typical, a per-head attribution can overshoot the true residual write threefold on reordered-normalization architectures, an interchange patch can go sign-chaotic because its outcome is pinned at a ceiling, or a read-from verdict can be an artifact of measuring past the layer where the model already decided. This note documents six such failures from a causal interpretability program on refusal and moral representation, spanning several papers and a four-model open-weight panel; each mode is established on one or two of the four. For each we give the tell that catches it and a protocol keyed to a detectable trigger (reordered normalization, massive activations, a low-dimensional decision channel), so we and readers can check whether a given setup is exposed. The discipline reduces to four moves: calibrate against a positive-control ladder, certify with an orthogonal cell, compute power before spending compute, and state every read-from verdict at a depth referenced to the model's commitment. The evidence is four architectures across three families within a single program; external replication across programs is future work.

AI.tldr: 大模型因果可解释性中的六类测量失效模式：会返回看似合理的数值而非报错，并给出识别信号、触发协议与四项规范做法。
AI.motivation: 因果性论断依赖测量（投影、余弦、消融差值、交换补丁等），但这些测量会以可诊断的方式失效，输出看似可信的数字而不报错，导致“坏仪器”被误读为发现。
AI.method: 在一个关于拒答与道德表征的因果可解释性项目中，跨多篇论文与四模型开源权重面板，识别并刻画六种失效模式，每种在一到两个模型上确立；为每种给出识别线索（tell）与对应可检测触发条件（重排归一化、巨激活、低维决策通道）的协议。
AI.result: 六种失效模式包括：协方差匹配零假设饱和至所有方向都显得典型；逐头归因在重排归一化架构上超出真实残差写入三倍；交换补丁因结果被钉在上限而符号混乱；从某层读取的判定实为越过模型已决策层所致的伪影等。
AI.conclusion: 规范归纳为四步：以阳性对照阶梯校准、用正交单元确证、在花费算力前先算检验效力、所有读取式判定须以模型承诺深度为参照标注深度。证据限于单一项目内三家族四架构，跨项目外部复现为未来工作。

title: Fabrication After Tool Failure: Tool-Augmented Agents Assert Values Their Tools Did Not Return
comment: 11 pages, 4 tables
summary: Tool-augmented language models are evaluated on whether they reach the right answer, not on whether they report honestly when a tool fails to supply one. We isolate this post-failure decision with a benchmark of 1,024 items spanning 16 internal-system domains and eight tool-failure types, in which a tool call is enforced and the returned payload is guaranteed to be unusable. Under a deployment-style system prompt, 14.10% of responses are dishonest: the model either asserts a value the payload cannot support or declines while citing a fabricated policy or capability limit. The rate is governed almost entirely by whether the failure is signalled. When the tool returns status:error, dishonesty is absent (0.0%); when it returns status:ok with a redacted, corrupted, stale, malformed, empty or truncated value, dishonesty reaches 45.3%. The behaviour is not an artefact of our prompts: it appears under a neutral prompt (10.17%) and under the shipped prompt of every production agent framework we evaluate, reaching 24.67% under CrewAI's, and none of the nine frameworks we audit specifies what the model should do when a tool fails. Comparing prompt-level defences, we find that the operative variable is not deference to tool output but the absence of a named failure state. Appending a single sentence that requires the model to emit retrieval_status: OK or FAILED before answering reduces dishonesty from 14.10% to 0.87%, with one item of 688 worsening against 92 improving, and transfers unchanged into three foreign agent scaffolds. The emitted flag is faithful in 99.7-99.9% of declarations, giving a runtime detector that needs only a regular expression.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个包含1024条样本、覆盖16个内部系统领域与8类工具失败类型的基准，用来隔离"工具失败后"的决策。结果显示：在部署式系统提示下14.10%的回答不诚实；诚实与否几乎完全取决于失败是否被显式标记（status:error时为0%，status:ok但值被脱敏/损坏/过期/畸形/为空/被截断时高达45.3%）。仅需追加一句要求先输出retrieval_status: OK或FAILED，即可将不诚实率从14.10%降至0.87%，且该标志可靠（99.7–99.9%），可用正则做运行时检测。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强语言模型的评测只看是否答对，而不看工具未能提供答案时模型是否诚实上报。论文旨在把"工具失败后的决策"这一被忽略的环节单独剥离出来进行测量与干预。
AI.method: 构建1024条项目的基准，覆盖16个内部系统领域和8种工具失败类型；强制发起工具调用并保证返回载荷不可用。在部署式系统提示下评测模型行为，并对比中性提示、9个生产级智能体框架的官方提示；进一步比较提示层面的防御措施，并跨3种外部智能体脚手架做迁移验证。
AI.result: 部署式提示下不诚实率14.10%；status:error时为0.0%，status:ok但值为脱敏/损坏/过期/畸形/空/截断时达45.3%；中性提示10.17%；CrewAI官方提示下达24.67%，且9个被审计框架均未规定工具失败时模型应如何行动。关键变量不是对工具输出的遵从，而是缺少一个被命名的失败状态；加一句要求先输出retrieval_status: OK或FAILED，使不诚实率降至0.87%（688项中仅1项变差，92项改善），并原样迁移到三个外部脚手架；该标志在99.7–99.9%的声明中真实可信。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强模型的诚实性主要受"失败是否被显式命名"支配。显式要求模型先声明检索状态，是一种极低成本、可迁移、且可直接用正则实现运行时检测的有效防线；生产框架当前普遍未对工具失败给出规范。

title: Refusal Reads Only a Slice of What the Model Knows: Harm-Keyed Routing and Its Exceptions Across Model Families
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Companion methods note: "Calibrating Interpretability Instruments Before Trusting Their Verdicts" (submitted concurrently). Per-unit arrays: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22731361. Code: https://github.com/deepsteer/deepsteer
summary: Alignment applied after pretraining is shallow in a measurable way: a single direction in a model's residual stream can be edited out, and the model stops refusing harmful requests. That fact says how easily refusal can be removed, not what the refusal decision was reading in the first place. We ask what it reads, and we separate that from what the model comprehends. Across four open-weight models spanning three families, moral comprehension is native to pretraining: a low-rank moral subspace crystallizes during pretraining, and alignment rotates it once without rebuilding it. The refusal gate, in contrast, is a fresh post-training construction with only a weak pretraining precursor, written into a narrow control-token channel where the refusal decision is orthogonal to the moral-judgment decision. The central result is causal and comes from one model, OLMo-3. A nested interchange rank sweep patches successively larger slices of the moral subspace between matched requests and reads how much of refusal's response transfers: as the basis widens, moral judgment keeps reading more of it, while refusal levels off at the level of a single harm direction, and about three-quarters of refusal's causal input lies outside the moral subspace altogether. Refusal reads the harm percept, not the moral content that judgment reads on the same patches. The picture is not uniform across families. Llama reads broad moral content; Qwen reads beyond the single harm cue but is unresolved at our sample size; GPT-OSS reads harm, and its refusals can be argued in either direction by its own reasoning trace. Where refusal reads only a low-rank slice and routes around the bulk of what the model knows, a rank-one edit removes it. Whether widening what refusal reads would also deepen the behavior is the open question this raises.

AI.tldr: 对齐后的拒答行为可被一个低秩方向移除，但拒答读到的内容与模型的道德理解是两回事：道德理解在预训练中成形并在对齐中被整体旋转，而拒答门是后训练新建的、经由狭窄控制通道读到的"伤害感知"，约四分之三的因果输入位于道德子空间之外。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明，残差流中单个方向被编辑即可让模型不再拒绝有害请求，但这只说明拒答易被移除，并未回答"拒答决策原本在读什么"。作者希望把"拒答读到的内容"与"模型真正理解的道德内容"区分开，并厘清二者的来源（预训练还是后训练）与所在表征通道。
AI.method: 在三个家族共四个开源权重模型上做表征分析：识别道德低秩子空间及其在预训练/对齐中的演化；定位拒答门所在的控制token通道；以OLMo-3为主做因果实验——嵌套互换秩扫描（nested interchange rank sweep），在配对请求间逐级替换道德子空间切片，测量道德判断与拒答各自能读取多少；并做跨家族对比。
AI.result: 道德理解是预训练固有的，低秩道德子空间在预训练中晶化，对齐只做一次旋转而不重建；拒答门是后训练新建、预训练前兆微弱，写入狭窄控制token通道，且拒答决策与道德判断决策正交。因果上，道德判断随子空间基扩大而持续读取更多信息，拒答在单个伤害方向上即饱和，约四分之三的拒答因果输入落在道德子空间之外。跨家族不一致：Llama读取较宽泛的道德内容；Qwen读到超出单一伤害线索但样本量下无法定论；GPT-OSS读伤害，且其推理迹可为其拒答提供双向论证。
AI.conclusion: 拒答只在低秩切片上读取并绕过模型所知的大部分内容，因此秩一编辑即可将其移除。"扩大拒答所读取的内容是否也能加深该行为"是本文提出的开放问题。

title: From Visual Feedback to Textual Reviews: A Multi-Agent Vision-Language Framework for Image-Grounded Review Assistance
summary: Visual feedback in the form of user-uploaded images and videos is becoming increasingly common in e-commerce platforms because it provides authentic evidence of product quality, defects, packaging conditions, and real-world usage. However, visual feedback alone often lacks the contextual explanations and subjective opinions necessary for informed decision-making, while many users provide limited textual feedback due to the effort required to compose detailed reviews. To bridge this gap, we introduce image-grounded review assistance, a novel task that aims to generate editable review drafts from user-uploaded product images. Unlike conventional image captioning, which focuses on objective visual description, the proposed task requires product-specific understanding, sentiment estimation, and evidence-driven review composition under challenging real-world conditions, including degraded image quality, excessive zoom-in, target ambiguity, and partial product visibility. We propose a multi-agent vision-language framework consisting of four specialised roles: product grounding, visual sentiment estimation, visual evidence generation, and review synthesis. The framework employs explicit intermediate representations, including product entities, predicted ratings, and evidence summaries, to improve interpretability and visual grounding. Experiments on a curated subset of the Amazon Reviews Electronics dataset demonstrate the feasibility of generating coherent, product-aware, and sentiment-aware review drafts from visual feedback. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to formulate image-grounded review assistance as a multi-agent vision-language reasoning problem, providing a practical step toward AI-assisted review authoring in e-commerce systems.

AI.tldr: 提出"基于图像的评价辅助"新任务，用多智能体视觉-语言框架从用户上传的产品图像生成可编辑评论草稿。
AI.motivation: 电商中图像/视频反馈日益普遍，但缺乏情境解释与主观观点，而用户又因撰写成本高而少写文字评论，二者之间存在信息鸿沟。
AI.method: 四角色多智能体视觉-语言框架：产品定位、视觉情感估计、视觉证据生成、评论合成；采用产品实体、预测评分、证据摘要等显式中间表示增强可解释性与视觉 grounding。
AI.result: 在 Amazon Reviews Electronics 数据集的精选子集上实验，验证了从视觉反馈生成连贯、产品感知且情感感知的评论草稿的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 首次将基于图像的评价辅助定义为多智能体视觉-语言推理问题，为电商 AI 辅助评论撰写提供了实用路径。

title: Loop-Back Authority in LLM Agent Teams: A Paired Experiment on Flat and Hierarchical Coordination
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, plus 21 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/cihatburak/loop-back-authority-llm-agents
summary: Does authority in AI teams improve the outcome? Organizational theory asserts that authority facilitates decision making, improving quality. Meanwhile, some nascent AI research suggests that revision under authority makes LLM output worse. Multi-agent LLM frameworks default to giving a Manager agent the authority to send a worker's output back for revision. Prior comparisons test the effect of authority using verifiable tasks. We conduct an experiment on an open-ended task, business-intelligence reporting, using a sample of 43 paired laptop products and 86 runs. Each report is written once by a hierarchical team and once by a flat team. We find that flat teams produce higher-quality reports, scoring higher on Utility (d = 0.42, p = 0.009) and Writing Clarity (d = 0.34, p = 0.030). The reports are the same length, but hierarchical team reports use 53% more hedging words such as "may" and "could", and each revision is associated with a 0.14-point drop in Writing Clarity on a 1 to 5 scale. Before any revision, the hierarchical team's first draft is indistinguishable from the flat team's report. In other words, the quality gap can be traced to revision. Authority improves quality when the Manager can verify the work, else when it can only provide feedback it has a negative effect on quality.

AI.tldr: 在开放式商业情报报告任务中，扁平式LLM团队产出的报告质量高于层级式团队；层级团队的劣势源于"修订"环节，且其报告对冲词显著更多。
AI.motivation: 组织理论认为权威可促进决策、提升质量，而部分新兴AI研究却发现权威下的修订反使LLM输出变差。多智能体LLM框架默认赋予Manager智能体将工人输出退回修订的权威，但既有对比实验多基于可验证任务，缺乏对开放式任务的检验。
AI.method: 以开放式任务"商业情报报告"为场景开展实验：样本为43对笔记本电脑产品、共86次运行。每份报告分别由层级式团队（Manager拥有退回修订权威）与扁平式团队各写一次，随后对报告质量进行评分比较。
AI.result: 扁平团队报告质量更高：实用性（Utility）得分更高（d = 0.42，p = 0.009），写作清晰度（Writing Clarity）更高（d = 0.34，p = 0.030）。两类报告长度相同，但层级团队报告使用"may""could"等对冲词多出53%；每次修订对应写作清晰度在1–5分量表上下降0.14分。在发生任何修订之前，层级团队的初稿与扁平团队报告难以区分。
AI.conclusion: 质量差距可归因于修订环节。权威在Manager能够验证工作时可提升质量；当Manager只能提供反馈时，权威对质量产生负面影响。

title: How broad is that claim? Mapping Generalisation in NLP Research
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main; the dataset and code are available at https://github.com/cx-diao/nlpgen
summary: Generalisations are common in scientific communication, even though they are semantically ambiguous. An automated method is needed to identify and categorise claims according to their level of generalisation, in order help detect an over-reliance on generalisations and possible misrepresentations of scientific findings. We introduce a comprehensive taxonomy of generalisations in the scientific domain, NLPGenX, which labels claims according to their level of generality and framing within the text. We operationalise this taxonomy with an LLM-powered framework, NLPGenA, that automatically classifies sentences from scientific articles into 5 different generalisation classes. We validate our framework with human annotators and use the framework to construct a large-scale dataset of NLP papers annotated according to generality, with auxiliary labels for hedging and vague descriptors (NLPGens). We use NLPGens to analyse the use of generalisations in NLP papers across multiple venues and subdomains, and to examine associations with citation counts, hedging, and vague descriptors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出科学文本泛化（generalisations）分类体系NLPGenX，并构建LLM驱动的自动分类框架NLPGenA，将科学论文句子分为5类泛化等级，进而构建大规模NLP论文数据集NLPGens，用于分析泛化使用情况及其与引用量、模糊限制语和模糊描述词的关系。
AI.motivation: 科学交流中泛化表述普遍存在且语义模糊，可能反映对泛化的过度依赖或对研究结果的误读。目前缺乏自动化方法识别并分类断言语句的泛化程度，因此需要构建相应分类体系与自动化框架，以帮助检测此类问题。
AI.method: 论文首先提出科学领域泛化表述的综合分类体系NLPGenX，依据断言的泛化程度及在文本中的表述框架进行标注；随后将其操作化为LLM驱动的框架NLPGenA，自动将科学文章句子分为5种泛化类别；通过人工标注者验证该框架；再利用该框架构建大规模NLP论文数据集NLPGens，并附加模糊限制语（hedging）和模糊描述词的辅助标签。
AI.result: NLPGenA框架经人工标注验证有效；基于该框架构建了大规模NLP论文数据集NLPGens，包含泛化类别及模糊限制语、模糊描述词的辅助标注；利用NLPGens分析了多个会议/期刊与子领域NLP论文中泛化表述的使用情况，并考察了其与引用量、模糊限制语及模糊描述词的关联。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了科学泛化表述的分类体系与自动化识别框架，并构建了可复用的大规模数据集，为检测科学交流中对泛化的过度依赖与潜在误读提供了工具与数据基础，同时揭示了泛化使用与引用量、模糊限制语等指标之间的关联。

title: Pull: Lazy Materialization of Working Memory for Stateful LLM Conversations
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. An earlier version was publicly released on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21984705). Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/wulun811/kongmen-pull
summary: As LLM conversations grow to hundreds of turns, full-context injection incurs $O(N^2)$ cumulative token costs, while lossy summarization or hard truncation irreversibly discards historical state. We propose Pull, a session router that maintains an addressable metadata directory via a local, deterministic Purifier (zero LLM calls, millisecond-level latency). At query time, the LLM lazily materializes only the turns it needs; unmaterialized turns remain accessible but collapsed. Unlike irreversible compression, Pull's materialization is reversible; subsequent queries can expand any collapsed turn. On LoCoEval (128 conversations, 12,780 turns), Pull reduces per-query context tokens (Phase 2) by 75.1 percent on single-hop tasks with equivalent quality ($Δ= -0.002$, n.s.) and by 72.0 percent on multi-hop tasks with no quality loss ($Δ= +0.017$). A controlled routing benchmark (7,831 queries x 10 methods) shows that entity lifecycle tracking is empirically a prerequisite for distance-independent routing. On BEAM 1M (14 conversations, 263 questions), Pull improves F1 by +55.2 percent over a truncation baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 Pull 会话路由器：用本地确定性 Purifier 维护可寻址元数据目录，查询时按需惰性物化所需轮次，实现可逆的历史上下文压缩。在 LoCoEval 上单跳任务上下文 token 减少 75.1%（质量等效），多跳任务减少 72.0%（无质量损失）；在 BEAM 1M 上 F1 较截断基线提升 55.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM 对话轮次增长至数百轮时，全上下文注入带来 O(N²) 的累计 token 成本；而有损摘要或硬截断会不可逆地丢弃历史状态，无法恢复。
AI.method: Pull 通过本地、确定性的 Purifier（零 LLM 调用、毫秒级延迟）维护可寻址的元数据目录，并在查询时仅惰性物化 LLM 所需的轮次；未物化的轮次保持可访问但处于折叠状态，物化过程可逆，后续查询可展开任意已折叠轮次。
AI.result: 在 LoCoEval（128 个对话、12,780 轮）上，Pull 将单跳任务的每查询上下文 token 减少 75.1% 且质量等效（Δ=-0.002，不显著），多跳任务减少 72.0% 且无质量损失（Δ=+0.017）。受控路由基准（7,831 次查询 × 10 种方法）表明实体生命周期追踪是距离无关路由的经验性前提。在 BEAM 1M（14 个对话、263 个问题）上，Pull 相对截断基线将 F1 提升 55.2%。
AI.conclusion: Pull 以可逆的惰性物化机制替代不可逆压缩，在显著降低上下文 token 成本的同时保持甚至提升质量，并指出实体生命周期追踪是实现距离无关路由的关键前提。

title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing)
summary: Performing deliberate mathematical reasoning in visual contexts is a hallmark of advanced Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and requires a sophisticated synthesis of perceptual grounding and symbolic logic. However, in the realm of mathematical functions, our investigation reveals a critical modality interference phenomenon: even advanced models, while performing textual computational reasoning, tend to disregard or misinterpret essential visual cues. To address this challenge, we propose Func-R1, which synergistically harmonizes precise visual perception and rigorous logical reasoning. Concretely, built upon an explicitly decoupled architecture, we employ a hierarchical post-training framework to progressively identify critical visual evidence and conduct in-depth theoretical reasoning. Furthermore, the Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) strategy is proposed to steer policy updating towards internalizing fundamental theoretical properties while dynamically rectifying heterogeneous visual information throughout the reasoning process. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Func-R1 delivers the optimal performance among open-source MLLMs, even surpassing GPT-5 with an 8.4% improvement on MathVerse's function-oriented tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大模型在数学函数任务中的\"模态干扰\"现象，提出Func-R1框架，通过解耦架构、层级后训练与PATO策略协同视觉感知与逻辑推理，在多个基准上取得开源模型最优表现。
AI.motivation: 在视觉语境下进行严谨的数学推理是高级多模态大模型（MLLMs）的重要能力，需要感知grounding与符号逻辑的深度融合。然而在数学函数领域，作者发现存在关键的模态干扰现象：即便是先进模型在进行文本计算推理时，也倾向于忽视或误解关键视觉线索。这一问题是本文的研究出发点。
AI.method: 提出Func-R1，协同实现精确的视觉感知与严谨的逻辑推理。具体包括：1）基于显式解耦的架构；2）采用层级式后训练框架，逐步识别关键视觉证据并进行深入的理论推理；3）提出感知对齐理论优化（Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization, PATO）策略，引导策略更新以内化基础理论性质，同时在推理过程中动态校正异构视觉信息。
AI.result: 在多种基准上的大量实验表明，Func-R1在开源MLLMs中取得最优性能，在MathVerse的函数相关任务上甚至超越GPT-5，提升达8.4%。
AI.conclusion: Func-R1通过解耦架构、层级后训练与PATO优化，有效缓解了数学函数推理中的模态干扰问题，验证了视觉感知与逻辑推理协同优化的有效性，展示了开源多模态模型在数学函数任务上超越闭源强模型的潜力。

title: Language-Guided Representation Learning for Robust Cross-Sensor Material Recognition
comment: Accepted for presentation at the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Robots need touch to manipulate objects safely and reliably, as many properties, such as softness, texture, and contact stability, are hard to infer from vision alone. However, vision-based tactile sensors yield different observations of the same material due to variations in optics, elastomer properties, and illumination, leading to poor generalization when trained on a single or multiple sensors. We propose a language-guided distillation framework for learning sensor-robust tactile representations. Language encodes high-level semantic properties of touch (e.g., rough, soft, slippery) that remain invariant across sensing hardware, providing a natural sensor-agnostic supervisory signal. We construct a 39K-sample touch-language dataset with human-annotated material labels and train a tactile encoder to align sensor-specific tactile images with language embeddings in a shared semantic space. We evaluate our approach for few-shot learning and cross-sensor transfer and benchmark it on six existing tactile datasets. Our method achieves 95% accuracy in the 100-shot setting, improves cross-sensor transfer by an average of 13.3% accuracy, and yields up to 19% accuracy gains across six existing tactile datasets. These results demonstrate that language-guided distillation enables scalable and hardware-agnostic tactile representation learning. Code and dataset are available at https://mashood3624.github.io/Language_Tactile/

AI.tldr: 提出语言引导蒸馏框架，将传感器特定的触觉图像对齐到跨传感器共享的语言语义空间，实现传感器鲁棒的触觉表征学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作需要触觉来感知软硬度、纹理、接触稳定性等视觉难以推断的属性。但基于视觉的触觉传感器因光学、弹性体特性与光照差异，对同一材料产生不同观测，导致在单传感器或多传感器上训练时泛化性差。
AI.method: 利用语言编码触摸的高层语义属性（如粗糙、柔软、光滑），这些属性在不同传感硬件间保持不变，从而作为天然的传感器无关监督信号。构建含39K样本、带人工标注材料标签的触觉-语言数据集，训练触觉编码器将传感器特定的触觉图像与语言嵌入对齐到共享语义空间。
AI.result: 在少样本学习与跨传感器迁移上评估，并在六个现有触觉数据集上基准测试：100-shot设定下达到95%准确率，跨传感器迁移平均提升13.3%，在六个数据集上最高取得19%的准确率增益。
AI.conclusion: 语言引导蒸馏可实现可扩展且硬件无关的触觉表征学习。代码与数据集已开源。

title: Zero-shot video highlight detection based on text descriptions and synthetic images
comment: 5 pages
summary: Detecting video highlights, the most informative or engaging moments in a video, is important for applications such as video summarization and content recommendation. We propose a zero-shot framework that combines CLIP, large language models (LLMs), and diffusion models. Given lightweight video metadata, such as a title or category, an LLM generates textual descriptions of likely highlight events. These descriptions are further converted into synthetic visual prototypes using a diffusion model. Textual and visual representations are matched to video frames using CLIP, enabling frame-level highlight detection without highlight annotations or dataset-specific training. Experiments on TVSum and SumMe demonstrate strong zero-shot performance, with particularly favorable results on TVSum. The proposed approach provides an effective framework for metadata-conditioned zero-shot video highlight detection.

AI.tldr: 提出一个零样本视频高光检测框架，结合CLIP、大语言模型和扩散模型，无需高光标注或数据集特定训练，在TVSum和SumMe上取得良好零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 视频高光检测（识别视频中最具信息量或吸引力的片段）对视频摘要、内容推荐等应用至关重要，但现有方法通常依赖高光标注数据和数据集特定训练，成本高且泛化性受限。
AI.method: 一种零样本框架：给定轻量级视频元数据（如标题或类别），先用LLM生成可能的高光事件文本描述；再用扩散模型将这些描述转化为合成的视觉原型；最后用CLIP将文本和视觉表示与视频帧进行匹配，实现帧级高光检测。
AI.result: 在TVSum和SumMe数据集上进行实验，展现出较强的零样本性能，其中在TVSum上表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为基于元数据条件的零样本视频高光检测提供了一种有效方案，无需高光标注和数据集特定训练即可完成帧级检测。

title: Mind Which Bird You Favour: Parameterizing Adequacy-Fluency Balance in Meta-Evaluation of Machine Translation
comment: Accepted by 11th Conference on Machine Translation (WMT26)
summary: There is a tradeoff in machine translation meta-evaluation between prioritizing alignment with adequacy versus fluency. The balance depends on the combination of translation systems in the meta-evaluation dataset. This system set is a small, filtered sample whose characteristics change heavily across years and language pairs; it does not represent the true system distribution. Consequently, the adequacy-fluency balance is often unrepresentative and subject to change. For sensitive domains, controlling this balance is critical. We expose this balance as a tunable choice. To achieve a target balance, we reweight existing systems while minimizing distortion from uniform weighting, ensuring the evaluated systems remain real and representative. We provide an exact optimization algorithm with theoretical guarantees and pruning mechanisms to compute these weights. To validate meta-evaluation internal consistency, we design a scorer-augmentation framework that establishes a known relative identity for the scorers. Results demonstrate that our reweighting method effectively controls the adequacy-fluency balance and preserves the internal consistency, outperforming prior approaches. Finally, we analyze the performance of popular scorers across a sweep of this parameter.

AI.tldr: 机器翻译元评估中"充分性对齐 vs 流畅性"存在权衡，该平衡受元评估数据集系统构成影响；因系统集为小型过滤样本、不具代表性，作者将其暴露为可调参数，通过重加权现有系统实现目标平衡并给出精确优化算法与验证框架。
AI.motivation: 元评估中的充分性与流畅性权衡取决于所使用的翻译系统集合，但该集合是经过筛选的小样本，其特性随年份与语言对剧烈变化，无法代表真实系统分布，导致该平衡缺乏代表性且不稳定。在敏感领域中，控制这一平衡至关重要，因此需要将其作为可控量加以处理。
AI.method: 将充分性-流畅性平衡设为可调选择；为达到目标平衡，对现有系统重新加权，同时在均匀加权的意义上最小化失真，保证被评估系统仍是真实且具代表性的。提出具有理论保证的精确优化算法，并设计剪枝机制来计算权重。此外，设计"评分器增强"框架，为评分器建立已知的相对身份，以验证元评估的内部一致性。
AI.result: 重加权方法能有效控制充分性-流畅性平衡并保持内部一致性，性能优于先前方法；同时对主流评分器在该参数扫描范围内的表现进行了分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将元评估中的充分性-流畅性权衡转化为可调、可控的显式参数，通过有理论保证的精确重加权优化实现目标平衡，并配合评分器增强验证内部一致性，为敏感领域下的机器翻译元评估提供了更可靠、可控的评估方案。

title: Crypto Accounting Bench: Evaluating Frontier and Open-Weight Models on Crypto-Asset Accounting Tasks
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Entendre/Crypto-Accounting-Bench ; code and evaluation: https://github.com/EntendreFinance/crypto-accounting-benchmark
summary: We introduce Crypto Accounting Bench (CAB), a benchmark for assessing whether frontier and open-weight language models can reconstruct the complete journal entry that an organization actually posted for a crypto-asset transaction. CAB contains 118 evaluation tasks drawn from 7 pseudonymized organizations. Each task combines transaction mechanics, asset quantities and base-currency values, wallet and legal-entity context, counterparty evidence, related transaction legs, recurrence, tax-lot evidence, and the organization's complete chart of accounts. The target is a balanced structured entry with every required account, side, amount, currency, and full-precision asset quantity. We evaluate 12 models spanning proprietary frontier systems and open-weight releases over 3 independent attempts per task, producing 4,248 trajectories. We report 3 metrics: Mean Score, Best@3, and Pass@3. Pass@3 is the fraction of tasks with at least 1 of 3 attempts that satisfies every rubric criterion and required gate. The leading model reaches 77.43% Mean Score, while the best Pass@3 is 56.78%. Deterministic diagnostics, read from each task's best of 3 attempts and macro-averaged across the 12 models, show higher base-amount agreement (97.8%) than deciding-account accuracy (56.3%). Together with the failure analysis, these results identify account selection and complete-entry composition as the main remaining challenges on CAB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Crypto Accounting Bench（CAB）基准，用于评估语言模型能否重建加密资产交易的完整会计分录，实验表明账户选择与完整分录构建是主要难点。
AI.motivation: 评估前沿与开源语言模型在真实加密货币会计场景中重建组织实际过账的完整会计分录的能力，填补该领域缺乏标准化评测基准的空白。
AI.method: 构建CAB基准，包含来自7个化名组织的118个评测任务，每个任务整合交易机制、资产数量与基础货币价值、钱包与法律实体背景、交易对手证据、相关交易分腿、重复性、税务批次证据及完整会计科目表；目标为含所有必需账户、方向、金额、币种与全精度资产数量的平衡结构化分录。对12个模型（含专有前沿系统与开源模型）各任务独立尝试3次，共获4248条轨迹，采用Mean Score、Best@3、Pass@3三项指标评估。
AI.result: 领先模型达到77.43%的Mean Score，最佳Pass@3为56.78%。确定性诊断显示基础金额一致率（97.8%）高于决定性账户准确率（56.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 结合失败分析，账户选择与完整分录组成是CAB上尚待解决的主要挑战。

title: Tone on a Budget: A Reference-Free Metric for Lexical Tone in Massively Multilingual Text-to-Speech
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures
summary: In Yorùbá, pitch alone separates \d{o}k\d{o} (husband, Mid), \d{o}k\d{ò} (vehicle, Low), and \d{o}k\d{ó} (hoe, High) -- the diacritics ARE the tone marks. Yet character error rate (CER), the standard automated metric for text-to-speech (TTS), is in practice computed from ASR output that drops those marks: a synthesizer can ace CER and still say vehicle for husband. We introduce DunDun -- named for the dùndún, the Yorùbá talking drum that speaks through pitch alone -- an automated, reference-free lexical-tone metric that needs no tone-labelled corpus. The gold High/Mid/Low sequence is read from the input text's diacritics (in TTS that text exists by construction, so no reference recording is needed); the prediction comes from the audio's pitch track. We validate three ways. Flattening pitch with PSOLA resynthesis collapses DunDun while CER does not move. Inverting High and Low in the answer key of 300 native recordings drives the two-class readout to 0.14, symmetrically below its 0.35 chance level -- a consistency check on the scoring path, not independent evidence. And three native listeners, over 67 blind A/B trials, pick the tone-correct clip 89.6% of the time (95% CI 80.0-94.8; p < 1e-4); whether DunDun tracks those judgements trial by trial is not resolved at this sample size. Applied to a massively multilingual zero-shot TTS model, DunDun shows what CER cannot: Yorùbá tone sits near the native anchor before any Yorùbá fine-tuning (0.567 +/- 0.02 over five decode seeds vs. 0.596; chance 0.33), despite the 21.4% CER the model's own paper reports; and a few hours of clean audio halve CER (5.6% to 2.7% by 5h, 1.7% by 15h) while tone saturates within the hour. On non-tonal Swahili, CER already captures the gains: the metric a language needs is language-dependent. We release the metric and the complete validation protocol.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DunDun，一种无参考、无需声调标注语料的约鲁巴语词汇声调自动评测指标：金标准声调序列从输入文本的变音符号读取，预测来自音频基频轨迹，可捕捉 CER 无法反映的声调错误。
AI.motivation: 在约鲁巴语中，仅音高即可区分 oko（丈夫，中调）、okò（车，低调）、okó（锄头，高调），声调由变音符号承载。而 TTS 的标准指标 CER 实际基于丢失这些符号的 ASR 输出计算，导致合成器即使把"丈夫"读成"车"也能在 CER 上得高分。因此需要一个能直接评测词汇声调的自动化指标。
AI.method: DunDun 为无参考指标：金标准的高/中/低声调序列直接从输入文本的变音符号读取（TTS 中输入文本天然存在，无需参考录音），预测值来自合成音频的基频轨迹。该指标无需声调标注语料。验证采用三条路径：(1) 用 PSOLA 重合成将音高拉平，观察指标与 CER 的响应；(2) 在 300 条母语者录音的答案键中反转高/低调，检验评分路径的一致性；(3) 三名母语听者进行 67 次盲测 A/B 试听。
AI.result: PSOLA 拉平音高使 DunDun 崩溃而 CER 不变；反转答案键使二分类读数降至 0.14，对称地低于 0.35 的随机水平（属评分路径一致性检验，非独立证据）；三名母语听者在 67 次盲测中 89.6% 选择声调正确的片段（95% CI 80.0–94.8，p < 1e-4），但该样本量下尚无法判定 DunDun 是否逐次试验与听者判断一致。应用于大规模多语言零样本 TTS 模型时，DunDun 显示出 CER 无法体现的现象：约鲁巴语声调在未做任何约鲁巴语微调前已接近母语锚点（五个解码种子下 0.567 ± 0.02，对比 0.596，随机水平 0.33），尽管该模型论文报告了 21.4% 的 CER；数小时干净音频可将 CER 减半（5 小时从 5.6% 降至 2.7%，15 小时降至 1.7%），而声调在 1 小时内即饱和。在非声调的斯瓦希里语上，CER 已能捕捉改进。
AI.conclusion: 语言所需的评测指标是语言相关的：对声调语言需专门的声调指标，对非声调语言 CER 已足够。作者发布了该指标及完整的验证协议。

title: A primer on evaluation methods for large language models in healthcare
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have a growing range of applications in medicine, and their evaluation is critical for ensuring they provide benefit and not harm. This evaluation can be more challenging than traditional machine learning for many reasons, including probabilistic and open-ended outputs, and behavior that shifts with prompt design and accumulated context. This review covers four key areas of LLM evaluation: principles of study design, statistical methods, capability evaluation and clinical context evaluation. Capability evaluation considers different benchmarks, including multiple-choice, agentic and multi-turn benchmarks, alongside operational metrics like token usage. Clinical context evaluation addresses establishing accuracy of free text outputs, such as human review and LLM-as-a-judge, and clinical trial approaches. Across sections, we describe underlying concepts and potential pitfalls, while emphasizing the importance of aligning evaluation methods with the research question. Together, this article aims to provide a pragmatic basis for designing and executing rigorous evaluations of healthcare LLMs.
